In some cases, the GM may allow you to perform an unobtrusive action without being noticed, potentially requiring another Stealth check. Keep in mind that speaking or making a deliberate loud noise immediately changes your status from undetected to hidden.

If a creature uses Search and you become hidden from it as a result, you must Sneak if you wish to become undetected by that creature again.

Failure A slight noise or other sign gives your position away, though you still remain unseen. You’re hidden from the creature throughout your movement and remain so.

Fumble You’ve been spotted! Throughout your movement, the creature continues to observe you. However, if you are invisible and were previously hidden from the creature, you’re hidden instead of observed for the duration of your movement.

By taking a -4-circumstance penalty to the check you can sneak at full speed.

AMBUSH CONCENTRATE FLOURISH

Trigger A melee target is either flanked, unaware or flat-footed against you and you have inflicted a critical with a weapon with the Agile trait.

Action Reaction

You make a Hard (DC +2) check against your targets Perception DC. The difficulty of the check decreases by one step for each size category larger than you the target is. The result of the check determines the outcome:

Heroic You may modify the critical result by up to 20.

Critical You may modify the critical result by up to 15.

Success You may modify the critical result by up to 10.

Partial You may modify the critical result by up to 5.

Failure The ambush is ineffective.

Marcus successfully strikes a flanked orc and inflicts a Critical Injury (AV 5+). Marcus uses a reaction to ambush and makes a stealth check getting a success. Marcus may modify the resulting critical result by up to 10.

SNIPING CONCENTRATE FLOURISH

Trigger The target is unaware or flat-footed to you, and you have inflicted a critical with a ranged weapon. The target must be within the weapons first range increment.

Action Reaction

You make a Hard (DC +2) check against your targets Perception DC. The difficulty of the check decreases by one step for each size category larger than you the target is. The result of the check determine the outcome:

Heroic You may modify the critical result by up to 20.

Critical You may modify the critical result by up to 15.

Success You may modify the critical result by up to 10.

Partial You may modify the critical result by up to 5.

Failure The sniping is ineffective.

SURVIVAL (Wis)

You use this skill to apply your knowledge of the outdoor in order to properly navigate and survive in the wilderness.

Untrained Actions: Sense Direction, Subsist Trained Actions: Cover Tracks, Gather Herbs, Track

SENSE DIRECTION SECRET

Using celestial bodies, natural features, or the behaviour of wildlife, you can maintain your sense of direction in the wilderness. Usually, you only need to attempt a Survival check once per day, although certain circumstances may require more frequent checks. The GM sets the difficulty and time required for this activity, typically taking just a minute or so. Unfamiliar or unique environments may require a minimum number of Survival ranks to successfully Sense Direction. If you lack a compass, the check difficulty increases by one step.

Critical You possess a keen sense of location and orientation. In environments with cardinal directions, you have precise knowledge of them.

Success You’re sense of direction is good enough to avoid you from becoming completely lost. In environments with cardinal directions, you have a basic understanding of their orientation.

COVER TRACKS CONCENTRATE MOVEMENT

Whilst travelling you attempt to cover any tracks which have been left by you and your party. You cover any obvious traces of passing and move at half your normal speed.

Others attempting to track you must succeed at a Tracking check against your Tracking DC to follow your trail.

Covering your tracks and those of a small group is relatively easy but for each characters’ tracks that you are hiding beyond the first four characters you take a -2-circumstance penalty to your Tracking DC.

GATHER HERBS GENERAL MANIPULATE

Gathering herbs is similar to foraging and can be accomplished while you are traveling or as your sole activity during an 8-hour period. If you gather herbs while traveling, your overland speed is halved. Spending 8 hours doing nothing but gathering herbs from the area grants 1 additional yield of each herb you’re gathering.

When you start your day of herb gathering, you must declare which herb you are looking for. If you have 5 ranks in Survival, you can search for two different types of herbs at once, and for each additional 5 ranks you have in this skill, you can search for one additional herb, to a maximum of 5 herbs at once if you have 20 ranks.

Each herb has a level-based difficulty. At the end of the time spent gathering, attempt a Survival check against each herb’s difficulty.

Critical You gather 4 yields of the sought after herb

Success You gather 2 yields of the sought after herb

Partial You gather 1 yield of the sought after herb

Failure You find nothing.

A single yield of herb weighs 1/10 of a pound unless otherwise noted in its yield section in the stats below.

TRACK CONCENTRATE MOVEMENT

You skilfully follow tracks, moving at up to half your normal speed. After a successful Track check, you can continue tracking for up to 1 hour without needing to make additional checks. In tense situations, such as during encounters, tracking becomes a single action, and the GM determines how often you need to make checks. The difficulty of these checks is based on factors like the freshness of the tracks, weather conditions, and the type of terrain.

Critical You locate a new trail or may continue to follow the tracks that you are already following. Additionally, you have a pretty good sense of the type of creatures that you are tracking (numbers, race, footwear etc)

Success You locate a new trail or may continue to follow the tracks that you are already following.

Failure You lose the trail but can try again after 1-hour.

Fumble You lose the trail and can’t try again for 24 hours.

By increasing the difficulty of the check by 5 you track at full speed.

THIEVERY (Dex)

You are trained in a particular set of skills favoured by thieves and miscreants

Untrained Actions: Pick Pocket, Trickery Trained Actions: Disable Device, Pick Lock

PICK POCKET MANIPULATE

Action 1 AP

You steal a small object from another creature whilst avoiding detection. The item must be Tiny or smaller and weigh no more than 1 lb.

You make a Thievery check as an opposed check against the creatures Perception DC to successfully lift the object. If the object is in a pocket, purse or is closely guarded in some other way the DC is increased by 5. The GM may also add an additional modifier if they deem that the item is particularly difficult to steal.

If there are any observers to your attempt to Pick Pocket, your check may also be compared to their Perception DCs to see if they notice what you are up to.

Success Your attempt is successful and goes unnoticed by both the target and any observers.

Failure The target that you are stealing the object from notices, or an observer does.

Be aware that your check automatically fails if the creature you are stealing from is in combat or on guard.

TRICKERY

MANIPULATE

Action 1 AP

You use trickery to palm a small, unattended object without detection, you must make a single Thievery check against the Perception DCs of all observing creatures. Regardless of success, you take the object, but concealment may vary. Typically, only objects of negligible weight can be palmed, although the GM can make exceptions based on the circumstances.

Success The creature does not notice your Trickery attempt.

Failure The creature notices your Trickery attempt.

DISABLE A DEVICE MANIPULATE

Requirements you have tools

Action varies

With this action, you can disable a trap or intricate device. The complexity of the device determines the number of successful attempts required to fully disarm it. Thieves' tools are often necessary, and the GM may require them or set specific requirements for disabling certain devices. In some cases, a device requires a higher proficiency tier in the Thievery skill to disable it.

You choose the amount of time you wish to spend disabling the device and apply the following modifiers: 10 minutes (+2), 1 minute (+0), 1 round (-5), 1 AP (-10).

Your Thievery check result determines how much progress you make.

Critical You successfully disable the device or make significant progress in disarming a complex device, achieving two successes towards disabling it. Your actions are so skilful that there is no evidence of tampering, and if the device is capable of being rearmed, you have the option to do so later.

Success You disable the device, or you achieve one success toward disabling a complex device.

Fumble You trigger the device.

PICK LOCK MANIPULATE

Requirements you have tools

Action varies

Picking a lock without a key is like disabling a device, with the difficulty of the check depending on the complexity and construction of the lock being picked (lock difficulties can be found in their descriptions). Higher-quality locks may require multiple successful attempts to unlock. If you don't have the necessary tools, the GM may allow you to use improvised picks, which apply a penalty to the check based upon their usefulness against the lock.

You choose the amount of time you wish to spend picking the lock and apply the following modifiers: 10 minutes (+2), 1 minute (+0), 1 round (-5), 1 AP (-10).

Critical You unlock the lock, or you achieve two successes toward opening a complex lock. You leave no trace of your tampering.

Success You open the lock, or you achieve one success toward opening a complex lock.

Fumble You break your tools.

SPECIALIST SKILLS

Specialist skills represent highly specialized knowledge or abilities that characters gain through unique circumstances rather than through regular skill development. These skills can be crucial for performing specific tasks that go beyond the capabilities of standard skills, reflecting the character's unique experiences, background, race, or exceptional training. There is no real limit to the number of specialist skills a character can have. This flexibility allows characters to continually expand their capabilities as they experience new adventures, acquire new backgrounds, or achieve significant milestones.

ACQUISITION

Specialist skills are not selected like regular skills. Instead, they are granted through the following various means.

RACES

Certain races provide inherent specialist skills due to their physiology, culture, or innate abilities.

BACKGROUNDS

A character’s history and experiences before adventuring may grant specific specialist skills.

FEATS

Specific feats, such as Professional Training, can grant specialist skills.

CIRCUMSTANCES

Unique story events or milestones might grant a specialist skill, reflecting the character’s growth or newly gained expertise.

SKILL CALCULATIONS

When a character gains a specialist skill, it automatically gains bonuses as detailed below.

BONUS

The total bonus for a specialist skill is calculated in the following way:

Level + Class Bonus + Ability Modifier +2

SPECIALIST SKILL TABLE

The specialist skill table below has a list of skills which may be selected or granted to your characters. The list is by far from comprehensive so feel free to work with your GM to create and select additional specialist skills.

CHAPTER 5 - FEATS

Ramirez, the time mage, sprang into action to save his endangered ally. Summoning his mastery over temporal magic, he aimed to halt the peril in its tracks. Yet, in a peculiar twist of fate, a breach in the timeline caused a massive hourglass to materialize instead, shattering upon arrival and scattering sand throughout the scene. Now, Ramirez faced an unforeseen challenge: navigating the chaotic sands of time to rescue both his companion and repair the fabric of reality disrupted by his misstep.

Feats represent specialized abilities that your character can acquire through experience, training, or natural talent. They enhance your character’s capabilities, provide new options for combat or roleplay, and can offer unique advantages in specific situations. Feats might grant entirely new abilities, improve existing ones, or unlock situational benefits that can set your character apart.

Many feats come with prerequisites that must be met before you can select them. These prerequisites might include skill ranks, specific ability scores, or proficiencies with certain weapons or tools. For instance, a feat might require proficiency with martial weapons or a minimum Dexterity score.

Feats allow you to shape your character’s development and focus, letting you specialize in areas or create a versatile adventurer. Each character begins with a number of feats based on their race and class, and you gain additional feats as you level up. Typically, you gain one feat at each career level, though some classes grant bonus feats at specific milestones, as detailed in Chapter 4.

By carefully selecting feats, you can expand your character’s tactical options, develop creative solutions to challenges, and unlock powerful synergies within your abilities.

FEAT CATEGORIES

Feats are divided into several different categories which are briefly explained here.

RACIAL FEATS

Your characters race will allow you access to racial feats at 1st level, 5th level and then every 5 levels thereafter. Racial feat picks may be used to select racial feats and any favoured racial feats.

ARCHETYPE FEATS

Archetype feats are a special type of class feat and may be selected only with class feat picks. Once you have selected an archetype feat, you must complete its progression requirements before you can select another. It is also important to be aware that some class feats might have an archetype as a trait, in which case you can select this feat if you already have the archetype feat.

CLASS FEATS

Your character will be able to select one class feat at 1st level. At 2nd level and then every 2 levels thereafter, you will be able to select another class feat for your character. Some classes may allow you to select additional class feats and this will be detailed in the class’s description.

GENERAL FEATS

General feats have no association with a class and usually affect skills and actions in some way. Your character will be able to select one general feat at 1st level. At 3rd level and then every 2 levels thereafter, you will be able to select another general feat for your character.

GRANTED FEATS

You gain a number of specific feats from things such as race, background and classes which you do not have to expend a feat pick for. Feats granted in this way do not require you to meet their usual prerequisites.

FEAT SPECIFICS

There are several rules which govern how feats work and how they can be selected.

FEAT TRAITS

Some feats will have traits which help how they work in play. Some feats will have traits that correspond to a specific race, archetype, class type or class. If a feat has such a trait, you must satisfy at least one of these traits.

FEAT PREREQUISITES

Some feats will have prerequisites which must be fulfilled before the feat can be taken.

FEAT REQUIREMENTS

Some feats will have requirements which determine a specific type of situation or action that must be present for the feat to be able to be used.

Be aware that unless stated in its individual description, each feat may only be selected once.

FEAT VS FEATSometimes, two feats may directly oppose or contradict each other. When this is the case, this must be resolved as an Opposed Check using appropriate skills (GM discretion).FEAT VS FEATSometimes, two feats may directly oppose or contradict each other. When this is the case, this must be resolved as an Opposed Check using appropriate skills (GM discretion).

RACIAL FEATS

Each race has a selection of feats available to them. As long as you meet the prerequisites, you may select a racial feat at 1st level. At 5th level and then every 5 levels thereafter, you may select an additional racial feat.

AGELESS KNOWLEDGE

ASCENDAN ELF

You have amassed a wealth of practical knowledge and life experience throughout your years.

Prerequisites at least 100 years old

During your daily preparations, you can take time to contemplate and reflect upon the experiences and wisdom you have gained throughout your life experiences to gain a +2 racial skill bonus to one skill of your choice. This bonus lasts until your next daily preparations.

AGELESS LANGUAGE

ASCENDAN ELF

You have dedicated considerable time to the study of languages throughout your life.

Prerequisites at least 100 years old, Linguistics 2 ranks

During your daily preparation, you can immerse yourself in old memories and gain fluency in a common language or one other language that you have knowledge of. You may read, write and speak this language until your next daily preparations.

AGELESS PATIENCE

ASCENDAN ELF

Your long years of existence have instilled in you a methodical approach to tasks, allowing you to work with meticulousness and precision.

Prerequisites Level 2

If you choose to spend double the usual amount of time in a skill check, you can benefit from a +2 racial bonus to it. Furthermore, you treat a blunder as a fumble and a fumble as a failure when making this check.

ALTERED CANTRIP

HUMAN

By exploring diverse magical traditions, you have adapted a spell to harmonize with your style of spellcasting.

Prerequisites BSB +1

Choose a cantrip from a magical tradition other than your own and incorporate it into your repertoire as one of your cantrips. When you cast this cantrip, you wield it as if it were an inherent part of your own magical tradition, seamlessly blending its power with your unique spellcasting abilities.

Be aware that this feat replaces one of your existing cantrips and does not add an additional one.

AMBITIOUS

HUMAN

You were nurtured with a spirit of ambition, encouraging you to constantly strive for greatness and set your sights on the highest achievements.

You gain any one class feat for which you meet the pre-requisites. You have the flexibility to choose this feat later during the character creation process, enabling you to determine which prerequisites you have met.

ANIMAL MAGIC

BEASTMAN

Your shapeshifting abilities have forged a mystical bond with the animal realm.

Prerequisites Level 5

You can cast calm animal as an innate verdant spell with the focus trait.

ANIMAL SENSE

BEASTMAN

You possess some of the senses available to your bestial side.

You gain either Darkvision or Scent.

Be aware that if your animal race does not possess a specific type of sense naturally, this feat does not grant you that sense.

ANIMAL VOICE

GNOME

You possess a unique ability to understand and communicate with animals, perceiving their sounds as meaningful conversations rather than mere unintelligent noise.

Prerequisites Burrower Voice, Level 5

This allows you to interact and converse with all types of animals, not limited to those with a burrow Speed. In addition, your connection with the animal kingdom grants you a +1 racial bonus to Diplomacy checks specifically when interacting with animals.

ARCTIC ELF

ELF

Your resistance to cold is superior to others of your kind.

Prerequisites Level 10, Tolderni heritage

You gain advantage on all saving throws to resist cold damage.

ASCENDAN MAGIC

ASCENDAN

You have studied one specific field of magic, more than others.

You gain a +1 racial bonus to Spellcraft checks and to the Save DCs of one specific magical school.

ASCENDAN SCHOLAR

ASCENDAN

You have dedicated yourself to the study of traditional ascendan arts and have developed a deep understanding of magic.

You gain +1 racial bonus to Arcana and Occultism checks. Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus to your racial specialist skills.

AURA OF POWER

HUMAN

You have always had an inner pool of strength which helps your magic last longer than that of other spell casters.

You gain +1 Power Point per character level.

BEASTMAN

HERITAGE HUMAN

You have the blood of an animal within you.

Prerequisites Level 1 only

How this has occurred is unknown, but it is likely that you have a lycanthrope in your ancestry. You gain Nightvision, or you gain Darkvision if your race already has Nightvision. In addition, you can select beastman racial feats. When you select this feat you must select an animal race as your lineage.

Your animal form is usually one selected from the common animal species native to your homeland. Subtle characteristics might include strange eyes, pointed ears, excessive body hair, a long nose, a long-forked tongue and just about anything else you can think of.

BESTIAL RESILIENCE

BEASTMAN

Tapping into your feral blood, you can shrug off pain and injury with uncanny endurance.

Prerequisites Level 5, Con +2

Once per day, when you are reduced below half your HP, you may activate this feat as a free action to gain Fast Healing equal to your Constitution for 1 minute.

At 10th level and higher, you also gain resistance to bludgeoning, physical damage for the duration.

BIG MENACING FELLA (OR LASS)

ADVANTAGE HALF-OGRE ORC

You are big and intimidating and know exactly how to use such traits.

You gain advantage on all Demoralise (Intimidate) skill checks.

BURROW VOICE

GNOME

You possess a unique understanding of the chittering language spoken by ground-dwelling creatures.

You can communicate with and understand animals that have a burrow Speed, such as badgers, moles, rabbits and squirrels. You can ask them questions, receive answers, and even use your Diplomacy skill to interact with them. The GM has the final say on which specific animals can be communicated with using this ability.

COMPONENT SAVANT

ASCENDAN METAMAGIC

Your innate skill with casting allows you to freely alter components when casting a spell.

Prerequisites Level 5

PP Cost +1

As a free action when casting a spell, you may change one component type for another. This does not change the amount of AP required to cast the spell but simply allows you to use different components.

CULTURAL

HUMAN

You have a natural inclination and curiosity toward the intricate workings of civilization..

You gain a +2 racial bonus to the Culture skill. You also gain a +2 racial bonus to your racial specialist skill.

DARING FORTUNE

HALFLING

Your boundless curiosity and insatiable desire to explore the unknown often lead you into uncharted territories.

Prerequisites Halfling Luck

You can attempt actions that normally require you to be trained in a specific skill regardless of whether you are or not. You gain a +4 racial bonus to such checks. If you use Luck of the Small Folk when you fail a check for a skill with which you are untrained, you can add your class bonus, when you reroll the triggering skill check.

DARKENED VEIL

KORNARGON SHADOW

You manipulate shadows, deftly drawing them near to envelop your surroundings in a shadowy veil.

Action R: Trigger A creature attempts to target you while you're concealed or hidden due to dim light or darkness.

You lower the Flat Check DC to avoid the attack by 2.

DRACORIS

ASCENDAN

The blood of the ancient wyrms runs through your veins.

You gain a +1 racial bonus to all interactions with creatures of the Wyrm type. Furthermore, your skin has a slightly toughened outer layer increasing your DR by 1.

DRAMATIC LUCK

CHANCE HALFLING HUMAN

Your fortune often swings to the extremes, turning even dire situations into moments of improbable success—or failure.

You may expend a conviction point to change the result of a skill check or saving throw to a 20. Luck however is a fickle beast and the next time that you roll a 20, the die is immediately changed to a 1 (which cannot be amended in any way).

DWARVEN SCHOLAR

DWARF

You have immersed yourself in the ancient stories, traditions, and knowledge of your ancestors, gods, and people. Through diligent study, you have become well-versed in the subjects and techniques that have been passed down through generations.

You gain +1 racial bonus to Crafting and Religion. Additionally, you gain a +1 racial bonus to your racial specialist skills.

EARTH SENSE

DWARF

Your profound connection to the earth and stone grants you an extraordinary ability to perceive even the most subtle disturbances that it may produce.

Prerequisites Level 5

You gain Tremorsense.

EARTHBOUND MIGHT

DWARF

You draw upon the potent strength of the earth beneath your very feet, channelling its raw power to unleash devastating blows upon your adversaries.

Prerequisites Level 5

Whenever you make a melee attack against a foe who stands upon the same solid earth or stone surface as you, a surge of energy surges through your veins. This grants you a +2 racial bonus to the attack check.

ELEVATED LINEAGE

HALF-ELF

Your elven heritage flows through you with exceptional potency, endowing you with features that reflect your elven lineage more prominently than the average half-elf.

Having been raised among elves and immersed in the traditions of your elven ancestors, you have gained a deep connection to your elven roots. As a result, you gain the benefits associated with the elf heritage of your elven parent or ancestors.

ELVEN MAGIC

ELF

Through immersion in the art of Elven magic, you have acquired a solid foundation in the mystical arts.

You may add any one PP 0 (cantrip) arcane or verdant spell to your spell repertoire. This is a bonus spell and does not need to be memorised and does not count towards your known spells. Additionally, you also gain a +1 per caster level to PP.

ELVEN MAGIC, GREATER

ELF

Your study of elven magic has continued further.

Prerequisites Level 5

You may add any one PP 2 arcane or verdant spell to your spell repertoire. This is a bonus spell and does not need to be memorised and does not count towards your known spells.

ELVEN SCHOLAR

ELF

The study of the ancient elven arts and delving into the mysteries of arcane magic has expanded your knowledge and understanding of the world.

You gain +1 racial bonus to Arcana, and Nature skill checks. Additionally, you gain a +2 bonus to your racial specialist skill.

ELVEN SPIRIT

ELF

You have honed your mind and body to be impervious to the paralyzing touch of ghouls and other flesh-numbing enchantments.

You are immune to the paralyzing touch of ghouls, rendering their attempts to immobilize you ineffective. Additionally, you possess a natural resistance against effects that would impose the immobilized, paralyzed, or slowed conditions upon you. You gain a +1 racial bonus to saving throws against such effects.

Finally, when faced with a condition that would restrict your movement or hinder your actions for at least 2 rounds, you reduce that duration by 1 round.

EMBRACE OF MORTALITY

ADVANTAGE ORC

Your life has been intertwined with the constant dance between life and death.

Prerequisites Level 10

The closer you are to the edge, the more alive you feel. When you are taking recurring damage or your injured value is 2 or greater, you gain advantage to all Fortitude saving throws.

EMISSARY

KORNARGON

You excel in the role of emissary between the Shadow Plane and the Material Plane.

You gain a +1 racial bonus to all Deception and Diplomacy checks.

ETHEREAL TRICK

KORNARGON

You have unlocked a shadowy secret.

Choose one cantrip from the ethereal spell list. You can cast this cantrip to your known spells and cast it using your Spellcraft bonus.

EXCEPTIONAL TRAINING

HUMAN

You’ve studied under a renowned mentor, who taught you the secrets of a particular skill.

You may select any one skill which becomes a class skill for you.

Be aware that this feat may only be selected for a skill which is currently not a class skill.

EXPERT OF AID

ADVANTAGE HUMAN

Life is too short to be a loner.

You have learnt from a young age that working with others helps you to achieve your goals with greater efficiency. You gain advantage on all checks to Aid.

FAST HEALER

HALF-OGRE

It is believed that the blood of trolls runs through your veins.

You gain Fast Healing 1 against all damage except fire.

FEROCIOUS CHARGE

BEASTMAN FOCUS

You move like a predator on the hunt, striking with deadly momentum.

Prerequisites Level 5, Str +2

When you move at least 20 feet in a straight line toward a target and make a melee attack at the end of the movement, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus to the attack roll and the attack as is treated as a Trip action (for 0 AP).

FIRE-LIKE BLOOD

ADVANTAGE DWARF ELF

Your resistance to heat is superior to others of your kind.

Prerequisites Azgar heritage or Elarni heritage, Level 10

You gain advantage on all saving throws to resist fire damage.

FOCUSED PURSUIT

GNOME

Your curious and inquisitive nature lead you to delve deep into subjects that captivate your interest.

Select a new Specialised Skill of your choice.

FURRY FRIEND

GNOME

You establish a deep bond with a chosen animal, forming a magical connection between you.

This connection grants you a familiar, a loyal companion magically linked to your essence. The specific type of animal for your familiar is your choice, though it is common for gnomes to select creatures with a burrow Speed. More information on Familiars can be found at the end of this chapter.

GENERAL VERSATILITY

HUMAN

Your innate adaptability and diverse skill set allow you to excel in a variety of areas.

As a reflection of your versatile nature, you gain a general feat. You must still meet the prerequisites for the chosen feat, ensuring that you possess the necessary skills or attributes to fully benefit from it. However, if you select this feat during character creation, you have the flexibility to choose the specific feat later in the process.

GRACEFUL STEP

ELF FLOURISH

Your movements are a mesmerizing dance, and even your steps cover a greater distance.

Prerequisites Level 5

As an expression of your natural grace, you can elegantly Step up to 5 feet not once, but twice in rapid succession for 1 AP.

GUIDING FORTUNE

CHANCE HALFLING

The fickle hand of fate has bestowed upon you a special gift – an uncanny knack for finding the right path and striking with unerring precision.

Prerequisites Luck of the Small Folk

You can use Luck of the Small Folk twice per day: once in response to its normal trigger, and once when you fail an attack check instead of the normal trigger.

HALF-ELF

HERITAGE HUMAN

Either one of your parents was an elf, or one or both were half-elves.

You have pointed ears and other tell-tale signs of elf heritage. Half-elves live longer than normal humans, with about double the lifespan.

You gain the elf trait, the half-elf trait, and Nightvision. In addition, you can select elf, and half-elf racial feats.

HALF-OGRE

HERITAGE HUMAN

One of your parents was an ogre, or one or both were half-ogres.

You are at least a foot taller than an average member of your race and weigh on average at least 50% more. You gain the ogre trait, the half-ogre trait, +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, -2 Intelligence, -2 Wisdom and Nightvision. In addition, you can select ogre, and half-ogre racial feats.

HALF-ORC

HERITAGE HUMAN

One of your parents was an orc, or one or both were half-orcs.

You have a green tinge to your skin and other indicators of orc heritage. You gain the orc trait, the half-orc trait, and Nightvision. In addition, you can select orc and half-orc racial feats.

HALFLING SCHOLAR

HALFLING

You have diligently honed your ability to maintain balance and move stealthily, skills deeply ingrained in the rich tapestry of halfling tradition.

You gain a +1 racial bonus to the Acrobatics and Stealth skills. Additionally, you gain a +2 racial bonus to your racial specialist skill.

HAMMERHANDS

HALF-OGRE ORC

Your hands have been honed through countless battles, their strength and resilience enhanced by the trials of combat.

Your unarmed attacks inflict bludgeoning damage. Furthermore, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus to all shove attempts whilst fighting unarmed.

HAULING SHADOW

KORNARGON SHADOW

Your shadow serves as a hidden storage space.

Prerequisites Level 10

You can use your shadow as a unique storage compartment by interacting with it. This process follows the usual rules for storing or retrieving an item from a stored location. Your shadow has a capacity of 10 lbs for storing objects, and these items do not contribute to the weight you are carrying. While stored in your shadow, the items retain their solidity but appear shadowy. Although they can be detected normally, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus to Conceal an Object (Stealth) checks when concealing the objects in your shadow, unless someone specifically checks your shadow for items.

HIDDEN EMOTION

ASCENDAN CHANCE

Your duty must come before all other things, even personal relationships and friendships.

You gain a +1 per level racial bonus to saving throws against emotion effects. Furthermore, once per day you may make such a check with advantage.

HULKING FORM

BEASTMAN

In your hybrid shape, you transform into a formidable and imposing beast.

Prerequisites Level 10

While in your hybrid form, you gain the effects of the Enlarge spell, enhancing your physical attributes and granting you additional reach and power.

HYBRID TRANSFORMATION

ALTERATION BEASTMAN CONCENTRATE MORPH

Your connection to your bestial heritage allows you to shift between your humanoid and hybrid forms. While you typically walk the world in your humanoid guise—appearing as a member of your native race with subtle animalistic features—you can unleash your true potential by assuming a powerful Hybrid Form.

Action 1 AP

You gain the ability to shift into your Hybrid Form. In this form, your appearance merges traits of both your humanoid and beast forms. Your facial structure, limbs, posture, and even voice may take on features of your animal side, whether it’s the feathered crest of a raptor, the furred muzzle of a wolf, or the scaled eyes of a serpent.

While in Hybrid Form:

• You gain a bite unarmed Strike that reflects your animalistic nature (e.g., fangs for wolves, beak for birds, tusks for boars).

• This bite deals 1d6 piercing damage and has the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits.

• It is considered a brawling weapon for the purposes of effects and feats.

• You gain a natural base DR 1

You may return to your humanoid form as another 1 AP action. You may remain in Hybrid Form indefinitely but cannot disguise your nature while in it—others can clearly perceive your hybrid state.

At GM discretion, you may choose a different natural weapon reflective of your beast heritage (e.g., claws instead of a bite) when you take this feat.

INCREDIBLE TENACITY

ORC

After surviving a harrowing encounter that brings you close to death, you possess the ability to gather your strength and endure even more punishing attacks.

Prerequisites Unyielding Tenacity

You can now use Unyielding Tenacity more frequently, once every hour instead of just once per day.

INDOMITABLE RESILIENCE

ORC

Your resilience surpasses that of most others, making you exceptionally hard to kill.

Prerequisites Unyielding Tenacity, Level 5

You gain a +2 racial bonus to all Dying Checks. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus to DB and saving throws against any spells from the Soul school of magic.

INNATE COURAGE

KORNARGON

You have spent your time dealing with the fiercest denizens that reside within the plane of shadow.

You gain a +2 racial bonus to saving throws against all fear effects.

INNATE TEAMWORK

HUMAN

Through your upbringing and focus on collaboration, supporting and aiding your allies has become second nature to you.

When you Aid an ally at a non-attack skill check, your assistance goes beyond a single act of support. After successfully aiding one ally, you possess the ability to extend your aid to additional allies who make the same skill check for the same purpose within the same round.

IRON HIDE

HALF-OGRE ORC

Your skin is tougher and hard to the touch.

Your DR gains a +2 bonus.

IRON WALKER

DWARF

Drawing upon the wisdom of your ancestors who once waged wars of old, you have acquired the knowledge of their time-honoured techniques. Through diligent practice and dedication, you have mastered the art of wearing massive suits of armour with remarkable ease and comfort.

Ignore the reduction to your Speed from any armour you wear.

In addition, the ACP for any armour that you wear is reduced by 1.

KORNARGON SCHOLAR

KORNARGON

You have delved into the hidden knowledge and secrets of your Kornargon brethren, gaining insights and understanding that few others possess.

You gain a +1 racial bonus to the Stealth and Planes skills. Additionally, you gain a +2 racial bonus to your racial specialist skill.

LUCK FOR ALL

CHANCE HALFLING

It would seem that your luck is contagious.

Prerequisites Luck of the Small Folk

You possess the ability to influence the fortunes of those around you. When an ally within 30 feet of you fails a skill check or a saving throw, you can channel your luck to grant them a chance at redemption. Instead of rerolling your own failed check, you bestow upon your ally the opportunity to reroll their triggering check. It is important to note that your ally must abide by the outcome of this new roll, even if it proves less favourable than their initial attempt.

Be aware that if you possess the Guiding Fortune feat, the effect that applies to attack rolls cannot be used in conjunction with Luck for All to benefit an ally.

LUCK OF THE SMALL FOLK

CHANCE HALFLING

Fortune favours your carefree spirit, offering you a second chance when the fates conspire against you.

Action Reaction; Trigger You fail a skill check or saving throw; Frequency once per day

You can reroll the triggering check, but you must accept the result of the new check, even if it’s worse than your first one.

MASTER OF AID

HUMAN

Your bond with your allies runs deep, reaching to the very essence of your souls. This connection fosters an unparalleled level of cooperation among your group.

Prerequisites Expert of Aid, Level 10

If you have at least 10 ranks in the skill you are Aiding, you may add your class bonus to checks with that skill made to Aid.

MENTAL FORTRESS

ASCENDAN

Your mystic control and meditations allow you to resist external influences upon your consciousness.

Prerequisites Mental Focus 5 ranks

Action Reaction; Trigger You fail a saving throw against a mental effect.

Whenever you fail a saving throw against an effect with the mental trait, you may immediately make a Mental Focus check and treat the result as a saving throw against the effect. If the result of your Mental Focus check is worse than your original saving throw, the outcome of the original save is unaffected.

MIND SPEECH

ASCENDAN

Your telepathy is more powerful than others of your kind.

Prerequisites Level 10, Share Thoughts

When using Telepathy as an innate spell, you are no longer restricted to speaking with only other Ascendan.

MONSTROUS VISION

HALF-OGRE HALF ORC

Your heritage has developed your sight.

You gain Darkvision, allowing you to see in darkness and dim light just as well as you can in bright light. However, in darkness, you see in black and white only.

MORE SMALL FOLK LUCK

CHANCE HALFLING

Your reputation for exceptional luck among your fellow halflings is well-deserved.

Prerequisites Luck of the Small Folk

Your fortunate nature grants you the ability to use Luck of the Small Folk more frequently; once every hour instead of once per day. However, if you possess the Guiding Fortune feat, you can only use Luck of the Small Folk when you fail an attack check once per day, even with the increased usage frequency. Keep in mind that you can still activate it within the same hour that you previously used Luck of the Small Folk.

MOUNTAIN STRIDER

DWARF

Your profound connection to the earth grants you the remarkable ability to traverse uneven terrain with effortless grace.

You treat difficult terrain caused by stone or earth as normal terrain for the purposes of movement.

Furthermore, any Balance (Acrobatics) or Climb (Climbing) checks on surfaces made of stone or earth, grant you a +2 racial bonus.

NECROTIC RESILIENCE

DWARF

Your resistance to essence energy is superior to others of your kind.

Prerequisites Thengar heritage, Level 10

You gain advantage on all saving throws to resist essence damage.

OGRE LORE

HALF-OGRE

You were raised by ogres, or you've devoted yourself to researching the secrets of the ogre race.

You gain a +1 racial bonus to Athletics and Intimidate. You may also add the Ogre Lore skill as a specialised skill.

ONE WITH THE MOUNTAIN

DWARF

A profound reverence and an unbreakable connection bind you to the essence of stone.

Prerequisites Stone Wise, Level 5

You gain Meld into Stone as a divinity innate spell with the focus trait.

ORC SCHOLAR

ORC

The gray orc seers and scholars taught you the secrets of your people.

You gain a +1 racial bonus to Athletics and Survival. Additionally, you gain a +2 racial bonus your racial specialist skill.

PACK INSTINCT

BEASTMAN

Your instincts are finely tuned to those you hunt or fight alongside. When surrounded by allies or enemies, your bestial senses sharpen.

You gain the Pact Attack creature ability.

PACK ATTACK The creature’s attacks inflict an additional 1d6 precision damage when attacking any creature within reach of at least two of its allies.PACK ATTACK The creature’s attacks inflict an additional 1d6 precision damage when attacking any creature within reach of at least two of its allies.

PHYSICAL MIGHT

ADVANTAGE ORC

Your experience with natural terrain has given you a physical edge when overcoming such obstacles.

You gain advantage on all High Jump and Long Jump (Athletics) skill checks.

POLYGLOT SAVANT

GNOME

Your insatiable thirst for knowledge and your experiences as a well-travelled individual have gifted you with a remarkable talent for learning languages.

You learn two new languages of your choice which must be chosen from common languages and uncommon languages. Furthermore, if you select the Linguist feat, you automatically gain an additional language.

PRIMAL SHAPE

ALTERATION BEASTMAN CONCENTRATE FOCUS MORPH

Your bond with your beast heritage deepens, allowing you to fully take on your animal form.

Prerequisites Level 5, Hybrid Transformation

You can cast the Shape of the Animal spell once per day as an innate ability, using your level as the caster level. The form you take must reflect your beast heritage (e.g., wolf, eagle, bear).

You gain one additional use of this ability per day at 9th level, and again every 4 levels thereafter (13th, 17th, etc.).

READ THE ROOM

HALFLING

Living in a communal setting has instilled within you a keen sense of attentiveness towards those in your midst. The close-knit nature of your lifestyle has honed your ability to observe and discern the behaviours of others, enabling you to readily detect when someone deviates from their usual demeanour.

You gain a +2 racial bonus to Sense Motive checks. Even when not using Sense Motive, your GM will make a secret check on your behalf, with a -2 racial penalty (and ignoring the above bonus) to determine if those around you are acting out of character.

Furthermore, you can use the Sense Motive skill to Aid others when making such checks.

RESILIENCE OF STONE

DWARF

You can tense your body making it rigid, to avoid physical harm.

Prerequisites Level 10

Action Reaction; Trigger You take a critical hit which deals physical damage

You may make a Level based (opposed) Fortitude Save to lessen the effects of the critical.

Heroic You gain CR 3 against the attack.

Critical You gain CR 2 against the attack.

Success You gain CR 1 against the attack.

Failure The critical is unaffected

SAVAGE STRIKES

ORC

When you strike your foes with unarmed strikes, they inflict severe blood loss.

Prerequisites Level 5

When you critically hit with a Strike using an unarmed attack, any bleed result is increased by 1d4. A critical hit with a severity of serious or greater still inflicts 1 bleed damage regardless.

SELF AWARE

HUMAN

You have spent a great deal of time within a community that promotes mindfulness.

You gain a +1 racial bonus to the Mental Focus skill and Will Saving Throws.

SHADOW MAGI

KORNARGON

You have spent a great deal of time studying the magic of shadows.

You gain a +1 bonus to Spellcraft when casting spells of the Shadow school and all such spells have their save DC increased by 1.

SHADOW MANIPULATION

KORNARGON SHADOW

Your shadow can perform simple actions at your command.

Prerequisites Level 5

You possess the ability to manipulate your own shadow, allowing you to perform simple Interact actions with it. This includes tasks such as opening an unlocked door or interacting with objects within your reach. However, your shadow lacks the fine motor control necessary for actions that require significant dexterity or checks to accomplish. Additionally, you cannot use your shadow to hold items.

SHADOW SENSE

GNOME KORNARGON

Your heritage is steeped in the art of illusion, and as such, detecting shadow magic comes naturally to you.

You gain a +1-circumstance bonus to both Perception checks and Will saves when dealing with shadow magic. Moreover, when utilizing Sense Magic (Power Manipulation) to detect active shadow magic, the penalty incurred is reduced to -5 instead of the usual -10.

SHADOWBORN AGILITY

KORNARGON

Your body possesses a remarkable degree of flexibility, rivalling the nimbleness of your very own shadow.

Prerequisites Level 5

When you Fumble a Squeeze (Acrobatics) check, you instead get a result of failure. Furthermore, when you roll a success on an Escape check, it is elevated to a Critical. In the event of a Critical, you have the option to Step up to 5 feet instead of simply Striding.

SHADOWY GUISE

KORNARGON

By weaving the shadowy energies around you, you can alter your visage, adopting a new guise that conceals your true identity.

Prerequisites Level 5

You can cast Self-Mirage as an ethereal innate spell with the focus trait.

SHADOWY WHISPERS

KORNARGON

You can speak to those around you by throwing your voice across distance.

You gain the Message cantrip which you may cast using your Spellcraft bonus.

SHARE THOUGHTS

ASCENDAN

You have an uncanny knack of communicating with other Ascendan without speaking.

You can cast Telepathy as an innate spell at will, but you can only target other Ascendan.

SHROUDED DEMEANOUR

KORNARGON

Your experiences have honed your ability to navigate treacherous situations and contend with malevolent beings. You are well-acquainted with the perils that lie in wait and the ominous creatures that inhabit the plane of shadows.

You gain a +2 racial bonus to Deception and Sense Motive checks.

SMALL FOLK RIDER

HALFLING

Raised amidst your village’s sturdy ponies and loyal riding dogs, you developed exceptional equestrian skills.

As a result, you gain a +2 racial bonus to Handle Animal checks. Moreover, if you happen to be handling a traditional halfling mount like a pony or a riding dog, you gain an additional +` racial bonus to your Handle Animal checks.

STONE WISE

DWARF

Your keen eye for detail allows you to perceive even the slightest discrepancies and intricacies within the stonework that surrounds you.

You gain a +2 racial bonus to Perception checks to notice unusual stonework. This bonus applies to checks to discover traps of a mechanical nature if they are either hidden in or constructed of stone.

You also gain a +2 racial bonus to all Stone Lore (specialist skill) checks.

STONE-LIKE ENDURANCE

DWARF

It is said that you have the spirit of the mountains running through your veins.

Prerequisites Level 5

Gain a bonus to your HP equal to +1 per level. You also gain a +2 bonus to all dying checks and all exhaustion checks.

SUDDEN FORM

BEASTMAN

You can shift forms quickly.

Prerequisites Level 10, Hybrid Transformation

Your Hybrid Transformation and Primal Shape abilities cost 1 less AP

SURE FOOTED

HALFLING

Your feet, adorned with a layer of coarse hair and toughened skin, effortlessly find secure footholds, ensuring stability and grace in even the most precarious situations.

You gain Advantage on all Balance (Acrobatics) and Climb (Climbing) checks.

SWIFT REFLEXES

ELF

Your heightened senses allow you to react with incredible speed and agility.

You gain a +10 racial bonus to your initiative, ensuring that you are quick to act in any given situation. Furthermore, if your initiative roll happens to be tied with an opponent, your reflexes grant you the advantage of acting first.

SWIFT STRIDE

ELF

Your stride is greater than others of your kind.

You gain a +5 racial bonus to your Speed.

TEMPORAL GRASP

HALF-ELF

Being born to a union between a parent with a human lifespan and another with an elven lifespan, your own existence falls somewhere in between.

Prerequisites Level 5

You can cast Haste as an arcane innate spell with the focus trait, albeit limited to targeting only yourself.

THE BIGGER THEY ARE

HALFLING

You have mastered the sling, especially when dealing with larger creatures.

Your base damage increases by +2 when you hit on an attack with a sling against a Large or larger creature.

TUSKS

ORC

Your tusks have grown to the point where you can use them to rend the flesh from your foes.

Prerequisites Level 1 only

You gain tusks as an unarmed attack. Your tusks deal 1d6 piercing damage, are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.

UNUSUAL MAGIC

ELF

Your natural affinity for magic has taught you some unusual magic.

You may add any one PP 2 ethereal spell to your spell repertoire. This is a bonus spell and does not need to be memorised and does not count towards your known spells.

UNUSUAL WEAPONRY

HUMAN

You have learnt how to use a weapon which would normally be uncommon to you.

You may select either an Exotic Weapon and treat it as a Martial Weapon or select a Martial Weapon and treat it as a Simple Weapon.

UNYIELDING TENACITY

ORC

Your unwavering determination in battle fuels your resilience, allowing you to push through the brink of defeat.

Action Reaction; Trigger You gain the Dying Condition but are not immediately killed; Frequency once per day

When faced with certain death, you refuse to succumb, keeping yourself on the edge of consciousness. As a result, you avoid the Dying Condition and maintain a single hit point. Additionally, any recurring damage or bleed effects caused by the attack is reduced by 2. However, the strain of the attack still takes its toll leaving you Injured 1.

VERDANT GNOME

GNOME

Your connection to the natural world grants you access to a verdant spell.

Choose one cantrip from the verdant spell list. You can cast this spell using your Spellcraft bonus.

VERDANT HEALING

GNOME

Your connection to the natural world allows you to draw upon its natural healing reserves.

If you rest for 10 minutes, you gain Hit Points equal to your level.

VOICE OF THE BEAST

BEASTMAN

Your animal soul resonates with the creatures of the wild. Through growls, gestures, and instinct, you can commune with beasts as if they were kin.

Prerequisites Level 5

You can cast Speak with Animals as an innate spell once per day. This functions as the standard version of the spell, using your level as your caster level.

You gain one additional use of this ability per day at 9th level, and again every 4 levels thereafter (13th, 17th, etc.).

WINGS OF THE WYRM

ALTERATION ARCANE ASCENDAN MORPH

With effort, you can call forth leathery wings from your back, similar in appearance to those of your draconic ancestors.

Prerequisites Level 10, Dracoris

Action 2 AP; Frequency once per day

Your wings remain for 10 minutes. The wings grant you a fly speed equal to your Speed.

WORLDLY

HUMAN

You get along extremely well with members of other races and cultures, and thrive in diverse environments.

You gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy checks made to interact with intelligent creatures without the human trait. You also gain a +2 racial bonus on all checks to recall knowledge about the customs of races and cultures other than your own.

ARCHETYPE FEATS

Archetype feats are a special type of feat which allow you to expand your characters class. Once you have selected an archetype feat, you must complete its progression requirements before you can select another. It is also important to be aware that some class feats might have an archetype as a trait, in which case you can select this feat if you already have the archetype feat. An archetype feat may only be selected using a class feat pick.

ADVENTURER

At a young age you developed the urge to travel and seek your fortune. It is often irrelevant what the mission is, but the quest itself and the loot and notoriety at its finale are what you thrive upon.

You gain a +2-class bonus to all attempts to Recall Knowledge about ancient history, peoples, and cultures. Additionally, you may make any one skill a class skill.

Progression Requirements Gained class skill +10 ranks

AEGIS

MARTIAL

Some warriors may proclaim that an aggressive assault is the ultimate form of defence, you harbour reservations towards such brash claims, as they reek of excessive confidence; in your seasoned perspective, the true embodiment of a formidable defence lies in the presence of a sturdy shield, serving as an impenetrable barrier between you and your enemies.

Prerequisites Shield Block, BAB +2

You are particularly skilled at using a shield in combat. You gain the Shield Focus feat. Additionally, when using the Fight Defensively or Full Defence actions whilst wielding a shield, you gain a +2 Dodge bonus to DB.

Progression Requirements BAB +10

ALCHEMIST

The delight of tinkering with alchemical formulas and substances has become a much-loved pastime for you, and your dedication to this pursuit has elevated your studies beyond mere experimentation. What was once a casual exploration has evolved into a refined discipline, as you have delved deeper into the realm of alchemy with unwavering curiosity and diligence.

Prerequisites Crafting 2 ranks

The Crafting skill becomes a class skill for you, and you gain the Alchemical Crafting feat. Furthermore, you also add Alchemical weapon to your list of attack proficiencies.

Progression Requirements Crafting +10 ranks

ANIMIST

You have entered a natural order of druids and learnt some of their secrets.

Prerequisites Nature 2 ranks, Con +3, Non-Druid

Each day during your daily preparation you may prepare and cast any two cantrips from the verdant spell list. You gain a BSB equal to half your level.

Furthermore, you may select either Handle Animal, Meditation, Nature or Survival as a Class skill.

Finally, you may also learn feats which are available to the Druid (Adept) class.

Progression Requirements Nature skill +10 ranks

ARCANIST

Through your ventures into the realm of arcane knowledge, you have not only dabbled but successfully acquired a repertoire of magical tricks.

Prerequisites Arcana skill 2 ranks, Int +3, Non-Wizard

You gain a spellbook containing four arcane cantrips. You can prepare and cast two of these cantrips each day. You gain a BSB equal to half your level.

Furthermore, you may select either Arcana, Linguistics, Planes or Power Manipulation as a Class skill.

Finally, you may also learn feats which are available to the Wizard (Adept) class.

Progression Requirements Arcana +10 ranks

ARCHER

You have wielded swords and other melee weapons, but they have never felt quite right in your hands. When you have a bow close to hand, it is as if you are complete. You did not begin as expert with bow weapons but would consider yourself to be close to one now.

Prerequisites BAB +2, proficient with a bow weapon

You specialize in all bow weapons. You gain a +1-class bonus to all attack rolls using any kind of bow. Your Fumble DC with all bow weapons is decreased by 1 and all your range increments are increased by 10 feet.

Progression Requirements Any 3 feats which effect missile weapons or attacks, +8 levels

ARMOUR MASTER

MARTIAL

You have dedicated yourself to extracting maximum resilience from your armour, valuing its steadfast and unwavering protection in the heat of combat.

Prerequisites BAB +2

You have trained for many hours to reduce the penalties for wearing armour. You may reduce the ACP on any armour that you wear by 1. Furthermore, you know how to preserve both yourself and your armour when in combat. Whilst wearing armour you gain Critical Resistance 1.

Progression Requirements BAB +12

ARTIFICER

Constructing things is more than a hobby, it is something that you have become very proficient with.

Prerequisites Crafting 2 ranks

The Crafting skill becomes a class skill, and you may select any one common (one that does not require an additional feat such as Alchemical Crafting) crafting specialty.

Progression Requirements Crafting +10 ranks

ASSASSIN

EXPERT

You use subterfuge and stealth to kill your opponents.

Prerequisites Perception 4 ranks, Stealth 4 ranks, Dex +3

You gain the Death Mark action.

DEATH MARK

CONCENTRATE

Requirements You can see and hear the creature you intend to mark

Action 3 AP

You designate a single creature as your mark. This lasts until the mark dies or you use Death Mark again. You gain a +2-circumstance bonus to Attack, Perception and Feint actions against your mark. Your agile, finesse, unarmed and ranged (within first range increment) attacks made against your mark gain the deadly weapon trait against them. If the attack already has the deadly trait, increase the damage by 1.

Progression Requirements Perception and Stealth both +10 ranks

Be aware that although assassins are primarily adept at terminating lives and often associated with malevolence, there exist a few who adhere to a strict moral code, targeting solely the wicked, the cruel, and those who embody unchecked aggression or wield excessive power.

BLESSED BY THE GODS

You have been infused with divine energy by the gods and can heal others with a touch.

Prerequisites Divinity caster

You learn the Lay on Hands Specialist Spell. Furthermore, you gain a +1-class bonus to all Spellcraft checks made to cast Divinity spells.

Progression Requirements Religion +8 ranks

CAVALIER

MARTIAL

You are a knight and warrior who specialises in mounted combat. You have a powerful mount that serves as your animal companion. As a team, the two of you control the battlefield and strike fear into the hearts of your enemies.

Prerequisites Culture 2 ranks, Handle Animal 2 ranks

You gain an animal companion that must be at least one size larger than you to serve as your mount. More information on Animal Companions can be found in the Appendix.

You also gain a +2-class bonus to the Handle Animal Skill. Furthermore, you may also use the Stay in Saddle action as a Free Action.

Progression Requirements Culture +8 ranks

CHAMPION

You have bound yourself by a solemn vow to uphold the principles and teachings of your divine patron.

Prerequisites Religion skill 2 ranks, Wis +3, Non-Crusader

You become proficient in the use of all armour and gain the Crusader deity trait (including the bonus feat granted).

Furthermore, you may select either Diplomacy, Intimidate, Religion or Sense Motive as a Class skill.

Finally, you may also learn feats which are available only to the Crusader (Martial) class.

Progression Requirements Religion +10 ranks

CLOISTERED PRIEST

CLERIC CRUSADER

You are a cleric of the cloth, dedicated to your study of the gods. You have spent your days in religious study, learning the ways of the gods and attempting to commune with them.

You may select an appropriate Cleric Specialist Spell, and you gain an additional 1 PP per caster level. Furthermore, you gain a +1-class bonus to all Spellcraft checks made to cast Divinity spells.

Progression Requirements Religion +10 ranks

ENIGMA

ADEPT HERITAGE

You have developed the ability to cast spells naturally and have never received any formal training.

Prerequisites Pure Learned Caster.

You are an Instinctive caster (see Chapter 9) and do not have to memorise your spells during daily preparation. You replace your Class Magical Tradition rules with the following:

At 1st level you may select any two PP 2 spells from your magical casting tradition. You may cast these spells as long as you meet the casting requirements and do not need to memorise them. You do not need to spend 30 minutes each day as part of your daily preparation as your known spells are always available to you.

Each time you gain a level you may select two new spells from your tradition spell list and add them to your repertoire.

At 3rd level and then every two levels thereafter, you may swap any one spell from your repertoire for a new spell.

You may also select any two cantrips from your magical tradition. These may also be swapped out as you progress levels as detailed above.

Furthermore, you may also gain additional spells by purchasing the Magical Discovery feat (see class feats later in this chapter).

Finally, due to the raw nature of your power, you gain an additional 2 PP per level.

GLEEMAN

You have delved into occult lore and the performance that goes with it..

Prerequisites Perform 2 ranks, Cha +3, Non-Bard

You have become an instinctive ethereal caster and may select and cast any two cantrips from the ethereal spell list. You gain a BSB equal to half your level.

Furthermore, you may select either Artistry, Culture, Occultism or Perform as a Class skill.

Finally, you may also learn feats which are available only to the Bard (Adept) class.

Progression Requirements Perform skill +10 ranks

GYMNAST

You have honed your body to achieve astonishing feats of grace, defying the bounds of human ability. Your movements are a mesmerizing display of agility and finesse, leaving your adversaries bewildered and struggling to keep up, transforming each battle into a captivating performance of artistic combat.

Prerequisites Acrobatics 2 ranks, Acrobatics is a class skill

The Acrobatics skill gains a +2-class bonus. Additionally, you gain the Agile Display ability.

AGILE DISPLAY

FLOURISH MOVEMENT

Action 1 AP

You Step 5 feet and may attempt an Acrobatics check against the Reflex DC of one adjacent creature with the following results:

Critical you may immediately Tumble through their space as part of this action. Furthermore, the creature is Flat-Footed against your next melee Strike which must be made before the end of your turn.

Success the creature is Flat-Footed against your next melee Strike which must be made before the end of your turn.

Failure no further effect.

Blunder you fall prone and your turn ends.

Progression Requirements Acrobatics +10 ranks

LANGUAGE MASTER

You are a master wordsmith, a lexicographer of great renown. Words and language are your thing

Prerequisites Linguistics 2 ranks, Int +3

You are an expert with languages and gain a +2-class bonus to the Linguistics skill. Additionally, you may select two additional languages.

Progression Requirements Linguistics +10 ranks

LOREMASTER

There those amongst us that believe physical strength and skill with a sword bring power. It is your belief that are wrong. The pursuit of knowledge in all of its forms is the one true power. You belong to the ancient order of Loremasters, sworn to protect ancient lore and learn from its writings.

Prerequisites A total of 10 ranks in Arcana, Culture, Linguistics, Nature, Occultism, Planes or Religion

You've compiled a vast repository of information that touches on nearly every subject. You gain a +2-class bonus to all Recall Knowledge checks.

Additionally, you may select two additional Lore specialist skills.

Progression Requirements Arcana, Culture, Linguistics, Nature, Occultism, Planes or Religion +10 ranks

MASTERMIND

BARD RANGER ROGUE

Knowing your enemies and their weaknesses is the key to their demise. You study an opponent’s flaws and use them to your advantage.

Prerequisites Either Arcana, Crafting, Culture, Nature, Occultism, Planes or Religion 2 ranks

You gain the Sense Weakness ability and also gain a +1-class bonus when using Recall Knowledge to identify creatures.

SENSE WEAKNESS

CONCENTRATE

After observing any one target that you can see, you can make a Recall Knowledge check. The amount of time you spend observing the target applies the following modifiers to the check: 2 AP (+2), 1 AP (+0).

If you get a minimum of a success result, that creature is flat-footed against your attacks until the start of your next turn; if you get a critical result, it's flat-footed against your attacks for 1 minute.

Be aware that once you have used this ability on a target, they become immune for 1 minute.

Progression Requirements Arcana, Crafting, Culture, Nature, Occultism, Planes or Religion +10 ranks

MEDIC

You deliver medical attention both on the battlefield and away from it without feeling the pressure that such work provides.

Prerequisites Medicine 2 ranks

You have focused on mundane healing techniques and intend to become a master of your art.

The Medicine skill gains a +2-class bonus. The DC of all attempts to stop a targets bleeding are also reduced by 2.

Progression Requirements Medicine +10 ranks

PRIEST

You have discovered a religious calling and learnt the basics of divine prayer.

Prerequisites Religion 2 ranks, Wis +3, Non-Cleric

You can prepare and cast two cantrips from the divinity spell list each day. You gain a BSB equal to half your level.

Furthermore, you may select either Culture, Medicine, Planes or Religion as a Class skill.

Finally, you may also learn feats which are available only to the Cleric (Adept) class.

Progression Requirements Religion +10 ranks

PRIMAL WARRIOR

RANGER

You have learnt to combine the primal power of magic with your ability to fight. Unlike other rangers, you have learnt to harness elemental energy and other offensive magic to defeat your foes.

Prerequisites Nature 4 ranks

When selecting your spells, you may pick spells which have the attack and save traits and may add one such spell to your spell repertoire as a bonus spell when selecting this feat.

Progression Requirements Nature +8 ranks

RUNEMAGE

DRUID WIZARD

You have learnt the magic of the ancient magical runes and use them to enhance your power.

Prerequisites Linguistics 2 ranks

The way that you cast your spells is different to other casters and you replace all non-somatic components with a new component called Symbol. When using the Symbol component your spells are changed in the following ways:

• All casting DCs are reduced by 1

• All Save DCs are increased by 1

• You must have room to draw the rune for a spell (in the air or otherwise)

• All Defensive Casting DCs are increased by 2

You also gain a +2-class bonus on all checks made to identify runic symbols.

Progression Requirements Linguistics +10 ranks

THIEF

You have worked with rogues for some time and have begun to pick up some of their tricks.

Prerequisites Stealth 2 ranks, Dex +3, Non-Rogue

You may select either the Acrobatic Bluff, Guarded Move, Mobility or Stealthy Strike feat.

Furthermore, you may select either Acrobatics, Deception, Stealth or Thievery as a Class skill.

Finally, you may also learn feats which are available only to the Rogue (Expert) class.

Progression Requirements Stealth skill +10 ranks

VANGUARD

FIGHTER

You scatter your enemies with mighty two-handed blows. You love nothing more than to be surrounded on all sides, just to put them on the ground.

Prerequisites BAB +2

Any weapon that requires two hands to use is your true friend. You gain a +1-class bonus to all attack rolls using two-handed melee weapons.

When using the fight defensively and full defence actions with a two-handed weapon, you gain an additional +1 dodge bonus to DB.

During your daily preparation, you may apply one of the following weapon traits to any two-handed weapons that you use:

Backswing, Disarm, Reach, Shove, Thrown (10’), Versatile.

Progression Requirements BAB +10

WARDEN

Having delved into the intricacies of tracking and honed your wilderness survival skills, you have augmented your repertoire with the invaluable tools and techniques of a seasoned ranger.

Prerequisites Survival 2 ranks, Dex +3, Non-Ranger

You gain the Favoured Terrain feat.

Furthermore, you may select either Handle Animal, Nature, Stealth or Survival as a Class skill.

Finally, you may also learn feats which are available only to the Ranger (Martial) class.

Progression Requirements Survival +10 ranks

WAR PRIEST

CLERIC

You defend the gods and strike down their enemies from the front line.

You gain a +1-class bonus to BAB, and you also gain an additional 2 HP per level.

You also become proficient with heavy armour and are considered to be martial (as well as adept) for the purpose of selecting feats.

Progression Requirements Religion +10 ranks

WARRIOR

You have trained with fighters and in the art of warfare to improve your combat prowess.

Prerequisites Athletics 2 ranks, Str +2, Dex +2, Non-Fighter

You may choose to become proficient in either all simple and martial weapons or all armour and shields.

Furthermore, you may select either Athletics, Climbing, Handle Animal or Intimidate as a Class skill.

Finally, you may also learn feats which are available only to the Fighter (Martial) class.

Progression Requirements Athletics +10 ranks

CLASS FEATS

Class feats are specialist feats which are only available to certain character classes or class types (Adept, Expert or Warrior). If a feat in this section has a class trait or class type trait, then you must have at least one of those traits to qualify for the feat. Some class feats may have an archetype trait, in which case this is treated as a class feat for the purpose of qualification. Some of the feats in this section do not have a class feat and are therefore available to any character class for selection.

If you meet the prerequisites, you may select any class feat.

ACCURATE SPELL

ADEPT

You are very precise when it comes to unleashing targeted spell attacks.

When attacking a target in melee with a spell, you ignore the +4 standard cover bonus that each target gains.

Be aware that this feat only ignores the static penalty for firing into melee, it does not ignore any additional bonuses that the target creature may gain from cover and concealment.

ACROBATIC BLUFF

EXPERT

You have learnt to feint using sudden movement.

You can use your Acrobatics skill in place of your Deception skill to feint in combat. Your opponent opposes the attempt with Sense Motive or Acrobatics (whichever is better).

AGGRESSIVE MAGIC

ADEPT

You know how to get the most out of the destructive side of magic.

All elemental spell attacks gain a +2-class bonus to the attack roll. Unfortunately, the things that live in dark places have taken note of your power and all Fumble checks and Resonance Events are made at +10. Furthermore, you provoke Resonance Events on a 33 rolled on any Spell Fumble or Spell Critical Injury rolls.

AGILE STRIKES

Your unparalleled finesse with nimble weapons exceeds expectation, showcasing a mesmerizing display of grace and skill.

Your multiple attack penalty becomes –3 for your second attack and –6 for subsequent attacks (rather than –4 and –8) for attacks that have the agile trait.

AIDING ARCHERY

ARCHER ATTACK MARTIAL PRESS

With a swift and precise shot, you disrupt an opponent's focus in combat.

You may use both the Aid Defensive and Aid Offensive actions with a missile weapon. Furthermore, these actions gain a +1-circumstance bonus.

ALIGNED SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC SAVE

Your spells creatures of a certain faith or demeanour.

Requirement Divine Caster only

PP Cost +1 or +2

You can cause your spell to only affect targets with either the chaos, evil, good, or order alignment traits chosen at the time of casting.

You can warp the spell by a further PP to affect a second trait.

ALIGNMENT CHANNEL

CLERIC

You have developed techniques to cause your positive energy to harm eternals.

Any spell or ability that you have which affects creatures of the undead type in a harmful way, may also be applied to affect eternals with the evil trait.

ALLIED STRIKE

CRUSADER FIGHTER

Your attacks inspire your allies to strike out.

Prerequisites Diplomacy 5 ranks, Weapon Focus

Action Reaction; Trigger You take an action with the attack trait

After making an attack action, you may choose a friendly creature within 30’ who can see and hear you. The chosen creature can immediately make a bonus free attack against one target that is within range. This is attack ignores multiple attack penalties.

ANIMAL COMPANION

DRUID RANGER

You have formed a bond with a specific animal.

Prerequisites BSB +2

You gain an Animal Companion, which accompanies you on your adventures and faithfully obeys simple commands. More information on Animal Companions can be found at the end of this chapter.

ANIMAL SOUL

DRUID RANGER

Your link with your animal companion allows you to ignore harmful magic that cannot affect your wild side.

Prerequisites Animal Companion

You can choose not to allow spells and effects to affect you if they would not be capable of affecting both your creature type and that of your animal companion.

ARCANE KNIGHT

ARCANIST

You have a little skill with arcane magic but are far from being an expert in such matters. Although your expertise lies in different fields, you do have access to some arcane tricks.

Prerequisites Arcana 4 ranks, Int +3

Your arcane prowess improves and you gain a caster level equal to half your level (round up) and low PP (1 per level). You may now memorise and cast a PP 2 arcane spell.

ARMOURED COUNTER

CRUSADER FIGHTER

You lock an opponent’s weapon in your steely grasp, pulling the foe off balance.

Prerequisites Survival 8 ranks, you are wearing medium or heavy armour.

Action Reaction; Trigger An opponent strikes you and inflicts HP damage with no critical.

You may use any 1 AP attack action against your target ignoring multiple attack penalty.

ASSESS TARGET

ATTACK FIGHTER

Prerequisites BAB +2, Warfare

Action 2 AP

You make a carefully considered attack against your foe in an attempt to learn their strengths and weaknesses.

You make a melee Strike against your target (which is resolved normally). If you hit, you can attempt a Recall Knowledge check as a Free Action using your Warfare bonus to learn about the target. This check is made with a -2-circumstance penalty but if you inflict a critical there is no penalty.

Once you have used this feat against a target, they become immune to it until after your next daily preparations.

ASSESS TRACKS

DRUID RANGER

You can discern certain details about creatures through their tracks.

Prerequisites Survival 10 ranks

Make a Level based Survival check against the creature you are tracking or against their Survival DC, if they are actively covering their tracks. If successful, you learn the creature’s base speed plus one additional detail for every point by which your check exceeds the Difficulty. The information you gain includes whether a creature has a climb or swim speed, its movement-based feats or traits, and possibly other information such as the creature’s diet, size, and obvious supernatural traits (a fire creature, for instance, may scorch the ground when it walks), at the GM’s discretion.

If you fail the track check, you may retry after an hour of further observation.

BARDIC LORE

BARD

You know a little about a great many things.

Your ability to pick up obscure knowledge and gossip grants you your class bonus to all Recall Knowledge checks. Furthermore, you may attempt to make Arcana, Occultism, Nature and Religion checks untrained, even they would normally require you to be trained in the skill.

BEYOND REACH

EXPERT MARTIAL

You have mastered the art of moving to avoid melee attacks.

Prerequisites Acrobatics10 ranks

Action Reaction; Trigger An opponent moves into a range where they can hit you with their melee attacks.

Whenever an opponent moves into a range where they can hit you with their melee attacks, you may make an Acrobatics check against the opponents Attack DC. If you succeed, you may as a reaction, move back five feet, keeping your opponent at bay by leaving the range of their melee attack. The opponent may then continue their turn and may choose to advance on you again, so long as they have movement left.

You cannot take the 5 ft step away if it would carry you into the range of a different foe’s melee attacks or if you are cornered and have no place to go.

BLIND FIGHT

EXPERT MARTIAL

You have learnt to fight using senses other than sight.

Prerequisites Perception 10 ranks

You ignore the concealed condition when attacking creatures that are within the range of a non-visual sense. You’re not flat-footed to creatures that are hidden from you (unless you’re flat-footed to them for reasons other than the hidden condition), and the flat check for a creature to avoid your attack when hidden is 15 rather than 10.

While you’re adjacent to an undetected creature, it is instead only hidden from you.

BRAVERY

MARTIAL

You have developed a will of iron when in the face of adversity.

You gain +2 circumstance bonus against all emotion and fear-based saving throws. Furthermore, you reduce the severity of the frightened condition by 1 each time you succumb to it.

CHANCE OF REDEMPTION

CLERIC CRUSADER

Your foe hesitates under the weight of their sins.

Prerequisites Religion 6 ranks

Action Reaction; Trigger An enemy damages your ally, and both are within 10 feet of you.

The foe must make a Level based (opposed) Will Saving throw.

Critical The target is unaffected

Success The attack result is reduced by 2.

Failure The attack result is reduced by 4.

Fumble As failure and the enemy is also Stunned 2.

CHARISMATIC CASTER

ADEPT

You manipulate your magic more instinctively than others.

Prerequisites Cha +2, Level 1 only

You switch your ability score for spellcasting to Charisma. Your PP, Spellcraft and all other casting mechanics now use Charisma instead of your allocated caster ability score.

Be aware that if you already have Charisma as your casting ability score then why are you taking this feat!

CLEAVE

MARTIAL

With a fluid motion, you cut through one adversary and seamlessly strike the next.

Prerequisites BAB +6

Action Reaction; Trigger Your melee Strike incapacitates a target and there is another within your melee range.

You make a Melee strike against the additional target; this strike uses your current multiple attack penalty but does not count towards increasing it further.

Drok kills the Orc in front of him with his first attack and uses a reaction to attack another orc which is also within his reach. The attack against the additional target takes no multiple attack penalty, but when Drok makes his two remaining attacks in his turn they will be at -5 and then -10 as the Cleave attack does not affect this.

COMBAT AWARENESS

FIGHTER ROGUE

You are constantly aware of the potential threats around you.

Prerequisites BAB +5

You do not lose your Dexterity bonus to DB when flat-footed. Additionally, you gain a +4-circumstance bonus to all Perception checks made to avoid Ambush and Sniping.

COMBAT DEFENCE

EXPERT MARTIAL
