You have honed your combat prowess to avoid blows and deadly attacks.

Prerequisites Int +1

When using the fight defensively or full defence actions, you may increase your bonus to DB and your penalty to AB by 1. At level 4 and for every 4 levels thereafter, you increase the bonus and penalty by a further 1.

COMBAT GRAPPLE

FIGHTER PRESS

Your free hand is useful even when it carries no weapon or shield.

Prerequisites BAB +2

Action 1 AP

Requirements You have a free hand which can reach your target.

Make a melee Strike against your target. If the Strike hits, you may use your free hand to automatically Grab your target. The target remains grabbed until the end of your next turn or until they manage to break free with an Escape check, whichever occurs first.

COMBAT REFLEXES

MARTIAL

You can make an additional attack of opportunity.

At the beginning of each of your turns when your actions are replenished, you acquire an extra reaction solely designated for making an Attack of Opportunity.

CRITICAL RESISTANCE (CR)Critical Resistance is an ability often possessed by creatures which increases the AV required to land a critical against you. If you have CR 1, the AV must be 6 rather than 5 to inflict a Minor Critical and a Light Critical would be inflicted at AV 11 rather than 10 and so on.CRITICAL RESISTANCE (CR)Critical Resistance is an ability often possessed by creatures which increases the AV required to land a critical against you. If you have CR 1, the AV must be 6 rather than 5 to inflict a Minor Critical and a Light Critical would be inflicted at AV 11 rather than 10 and so on.

COMBAT REFLEXES, IMPROVED

You are the master of opportunity attacking.

Prerequisites BAB +10, Dex +2, Combat Reflexes

At the start of each of your turns when you regain your actions, you gain an additional amount of reactions which may be used to make attacks of opportunity equal to your Dex. Furthermore, you can still make a single attack of opportunity each round even if you are flat-footed.

COMPONENT MASTERY

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You can manipulate the components required to cast a spell.

PP Cost +2

When casting a spell with one or more components, you may Warp the spell to change a component type.

CONDUCTIVE HEALING

CLERIC METAMAGIC

As a conduit of positive energy, you serve as a vessel for its healing power, allowing it to mend your minor wounds.

Whenever you cast a spell with the healing trait to restore Hit Points to a target other than yourself, you also regain Hit Points equal to half the PP cost of the spell.

Be aware that if you manage to save PP with a Critical or Heroic result on your casting check, this does not affect the amount of HP that you are healed when using this feat.

CONSTANT GUARD

MARTIAL

Your shield is always available to defend with.

Prerequisites BAB +12

Requirements You are wielding a shield.

You may apply your Shield bonus to DB in combat even in the surprise round or if you are flat-footed.

CRITICAL FOCUS

MARTIAL

You know how to place your blows with precision so that they really hurt.

Prerequisites BAB +12

Action Reaction; Trigger Your last action was a melee or missile attack which inflicted a critical.

When you inflict a critical hit, you may modify the critical result by up to 5.

CRITICAL RESILIENCE

MARTIAL

You are tough, really tough and blows that would drop a lesser warrior barely slow you down.

Prerequisites BAB +8

Your ability to withstand punishment and damage surpass that of lesser warriors. You gain Critical Resistance 1.

CRITICAL RESILIENCE, IMPROVED

MARTIAL

You are so hard to kill.

Prerequisites BAB +16, Critical Resilience

The Critical Resistance that you gain increases to 2.

DEIFIC DISRUPTION

CLERIC CRUSADER

You can channel raw divine power to disrupt an opponent’s attack against an ally.

Prerequisites Caster Level 10

Action Reaction; Trigger An enemy that you can see within 30 feet hits an ally with an attack.

You immediately sacrifice an amount of PP (up to your maximum) to deflect the blow. The attack takes a circumstance penalty equal to the PP expended.

DISARM BLOCK

AEGIS

As you block with your shield, you also attempt to knock the attackers weapon out of their hand.

Prerequisites BAB +4

Action Free; Trigger An attack fails to inflict damage to you due to missing by your Shield DB.

You may make a Disarm attempt against the creature whose attack you blocked.

Be aware that you do not need a free hand to use this feat.

DISARM STANCE

EXPERT FIGHTER STANCE

You have far greater control of your weapon whilst in this stance.

Requirements You are wielding a weapon in one hand and have the other hand(s) free.

Whilst in this stance you gain a +1-circumstance bonus on all Disarm checks. Additionally, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus to your Attack DC when defending against checks to Disarm you. Finally, you ignore the first -2 penalty received for disarming creatures larger than you.

DISRUPTING STANCE

FIGHTER ROGUE STANCE

You possess an unwavering focus that turns even the smallest distraction into a catalyst for your fury, allowing you to effortlessly thwart the actions of your adversaries.

Prerequisites BAB +10

Whilst in this stance, any creatures within your reach that use a Concentrate action provoke an Attack of Opportunity. Furthermore, if the interrupted action is a spell, it applies a -4-circumstance penalty to any Spell Concentration checks made to recover.

DISTANT SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You can cast spells upon others that normally only affect yourself.

PP Cost +4

Change a spell that only affects you to a range of touch.

Be aware that Ethereal Casters can use this option for PP +6

DISTRACTING STRIKE

ATTACK FIGHTER

You perform a distracting manoeuvre with your free hand which distracts the target.

Requirements You have one hand free, and your target is within reach of that hand.

Action 1 AP

Make a Strike and if it hits, the target takes no damage (normal damage on a critical hit) but is flat-footed until the beginning of their next turn.

DIVINE KNIGHT

PRIEST

You are an ordained priest and have even learned how to cast a few divine spells.

Prerequisites Religion 4 ranks, Wis +3

Your divine prowess improves and you gain a caster level equal to half your level (round up) and low PP (1 per level). You may now memorise and cast a PP 2 divinity spell.

DOUBLE SHOT

ARCHER FLOURISH MARTIAL

With lightning speed, you unleash a flurry of arrows, firing twice in rapid succession.

Prerequisites BAB +4

Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon and can reload it for 0 actions.

Action 2 AP

Make two Strikes, each against different targets, with a –2 circumstance penalty. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn’t increase until after both Strikes have been completed.

DOUBLE STANCE

MARTIAL ROGUE STANCE

Your skill when using two weapons is better than most.

Action 1 AP

Whilst in this stance, Double Slice only costs you 2 AP and you only take a -1 penalty for your second weapon if it does not have the agile trait.

DUELLING DANCE

MARTIAL

Your balance with your weapon allows you to attack and defend in tandem.

Prerequisites Duelling Parry, BAB +10

Requirements You are wielding a weapon in one hand and have the other hand(s) free.

Whilst using the Duelling Parry Stance, your AP cost to Fight Defensively is reduced to 1.

DUELLING PARRY

MARTIAL STANCE

You have trained to deflect incoming attacks.

Prerequisites BAB +2

Requirements You are wielding a weapon in one hand and have the other hand(s) free.

Your Dodge bonus when fighting defensively is increased by +2 if you continue to meet the requirements.

DUELLING RIPOSTE

FIGHTER

You riposte against an enemy that makes an error.

Prerequisites Duelling Parry, BAB +6

Requirements You are wielding a weapon in one hand and have the other hand(s) free.

Action Reaction; Trigger A creature within your reach fumbles a Strike.

You may take either an Attack or Disarm action against the target. Your multiple attack penalty does not apply to this action.

ECHOING PERFORMANCE

BARD METAMAGIC

Your Bardic Specialist spells echo and harmonise with themselves.

Requirements Lingering Performance, Level 8

Your lingering performance now lasts an additional round, and you may have two lingering performances running at any one time.

ECONOMIC SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You have developed the ability to use less power when casting spells, although this makes the casting more difficult.

Action +1 AP

When casting a spell, you may choose to lower the PP cost of a spell by up to your caster level (min 1 PP). The DC to cast the spell increases by 2 for every PP you lower by.

EFFORTLESS SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC OPEN

You maintain a spell with hardly a thought.

Action Free; PP Cost +1

By expending 1 PP, you immediately gain the effects of the Sustain a Spell action, allowing you to extend the duration of one of your active spells.

ELEMENTAL SHAPE

DRUID

Your comprehension of primal forces enables you to infuse them within your very being, allowing you to become a living manifestation of those elemental powers.

Prerequisites Wild Shape, BSB +10

You may use your Wild Shape ability to take the form of an elemental as if using the Shape of the Elemental spell.

Furthermore, whenever you use Wildshape to change into a different form, you gain resistance to either acid, cold, electricity or fire for the duration.

ELEMENTAL SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You have learnt to change the elemental type of your spell as you cast it.

PP Cost +2

Choose one energy type: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. You may replace a spell's normal damage with that energy type or split the spell's damage, so that half is of that energy type and half is of its normal type.

This feat may be taken multiple times, each time selecting either acid, cold electricity or fire.

ELOQUENCE

ADEPT

You have focused your mastery of magic and spent many hours perfecting such arts.

The DC for all Spellcraft checks made to cast spells of your tradition is reduced by 1.

EMPOWER FAMILIAR

WIZARD

You imbue your familiar with additional magical energy, augmenting its powers and capabilities.

Prerequisites Familiar, Caster Level 2

You can select any two familiar abilities for your familiar. More information on Familiars can be found at the end of this chapter.

EMPOWER SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You can inflict more damage with your spells.

PP Cost +1

Add an additional amount of damage equal to the spells base damage.

EVASION

ADVANTAGE EXPERT RANGER

Your ability to evade area spell attacks and breath weapons is remarkably efficient..

Prerequisites Acrobatics 6 ranks

Action Reaction; Trigger You attempt a reflex save, before you roll.

You gain advantage on the triggering saving throw.

EXTEND SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You can make your spells last longer than most.

PP Cost +2

An extended spell lasts twice as long as normal. A spell must have a limited duration to be affected by this Warping Option.

EXTRA CHANNELS

CLERIC

Your bond with your deific aspect is stronger, granting you more healing power..

Prerequisites BSB +4

You can channel energy two additional times per day.

EXTRA MERCY

CRUSADER

Your constant communion with your deific aspect has reaped its reward.

Prerequisites BAB +4

You can use Crusaders Mercy two additional times per day.

EXTRA WILDSHAPE

DRUID

Your bond with nature grants you more control over your form.

Prerequisites BSB +8

You can Wildshape two additional times per day.

FAMILIAR

WIZARD

You use your magical energy to form a familiar.

You gain a familiar. More information on Familiars can be found at the end of this chapter.

FAR SHOT

ARCHER RANGER

You have greater accuracy at longer ranges with bow weapons.

Prerequisites BAB +4

The range increment for all ranged weapons is doubled for you.

FAR THROW

EXPERT MARTIAL

You get much greater distance on a thrown weapon.

When you make an attack with a thrown weapon, you increase your first range increment by 10 feet.

FAST AIM

ARCHER FIGHTER RANGER

You are not easily flustered when using the aim action.

It takes you one less action to use the Aim action and you are not Flat-Footed whilst aiming.

FAST ATTACK

MARTIAL

Prerequisites BAB +10

The speed of your attacks often takes those around you by surprise.

You gain one additional AP each round which may only be used to make a Strike action. This action is subject to usual multiple attack penalties.

FAVOURED TERRAIN

DRUID RANGER

You favour a specific terrain type and are far more proficient within its confines.

Choose either aquatic, arctic, desert, mountain, plains, sky, swamp, underground or woodland as your favoured terrain. When in your favoured terrain you gain a +2-class bonus on Nature, Perception, Stealth and Survival checks.

Additionally, you gain a +10-class bonus to any Initiative checks made within your favoured terrain.

Finally, the DC for all Spellcraft checks made to cast verdant spells is reduced by 1 whilst in your favoured terrain.

This feat may be taken multiple times, each time selecting a new terrain type.

FEARLESS

MARTIAL

Your ability to ignore the terrifying sights before you have increased to legendary proportions.

Prerequisites Bravery, BAB +14

You are immune to fear.

FEROCIOUS SHAPE

DRUID

You have learnt how to fight whilst in a wild shaped form.

Prerequisites Wild Shape, BSB +6

You gain a +2-circumstance bonus to all natural attacks and a +2-dodge bonus to DB when using your Wildshape ability.

FOCUSED STRIKE

FIGHTER PRESS

You don’t easily lose your concentration when an attack misses.

You balance your attack perfectly delivering a skilful strike which only counts towards your multiple attack penalty if it hits your target.

FRENZY

MARTIAL

You can focus your mind and enter a killer frenzy.

You may use both the Invoke Rage (Mental Focus) and Revoke Rage (Mental Focus) actions.

FURIOUS FOCUS

FIGHTER

Through dedicated practice and unwavering discipline, you have mastered the art of maintaining perfect balance even amidst a frenzy of furious swings and attacks.

Prerequisites BAB +8, Power Attack

When using Power Attack, it only counts as one attack for the purposes of your multiple attack penalty.

Be aware that Power Attack still costs 2 AP to use when using this feat.

GREAT CLEAVE

FIGHTER

Once the killing begins, your fury knows no mercy.

Prerequisites Cleave, BAB +10

When you use the Cleave feat, your momentum allows you to unleash a continuous onslaught of melee Strikes. You can keep attacking with melee Strikes until you fail to incapacitate a creature or until there are no more adjacent creatures left to attack, whichever condition is met first.

GUARDED MOVE

DEFENCE MOVEMENT ROGUE

You can anticipate attacks whilst moving.

Action 1 AP

You take a Stride action whilst your guard is up, wary of incoming attacks. You gain a +4-circumstance bonus to DB against any attacks which are provoked by your movement until the beginning of your next turn.

GUARDIAN DEFENCE

MARTIAL

You can aid your allies in the blink of an eye.

Requirements You are wielding a one-handed weapon or shield.

Action Reaction; Trigger An ally within your melee reach is hit by an attack and you can see the attacker.

You can make an immediate Aid Defensive action and reduce the attack by the indicated amount.

HEALING CHANNEL

CLERIC CRUSADER

You can enhance your medical skills with prayer.

When using the Medicine skill to heal the injuries of a target, you may expend PP to grant yourself a bonus to the check. You may expend an amount of PP equal to half your caster level (round up) to a maximum of 5 PP. Each PP grants you a +1-class bonus to the medicine check. Furthermore, when casting the Cure spell, the amount healed is increased to d10’s (and +10 for ranged).

HEIGHTEN SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC

Your spells are harder to resist.

PP Cost +2

When you heighten a spell, you are increasing its raw power level which makes it more difficult to dispel (and potentially resist). Heightening a spell treats the PP of the spell for Saving Throw DC purposes as the maximum PP that you can cast.

Salios is Wizard with a caster level of 13. The maximum PP spell that he can cast is 14. He casts a Blindness spell and uses the Heighten Feat which increase the PP cost of the spell by 2 (from 6 to 8) but the spell is treated as PP 14 for the purposes of the Saving Throw DC.

HONED REFLEXES

MARTIAL ROGUE

Your reactions are so sharp that you can react to almost any situation in the blink of an eye.

Prerequisites BAB +10

You gain an additional reaction each turn.

HUMANOID SHAPE

DRUID

Like the ever-shifting weather, your physical form is malleable and adaptable, capable of transforming at will to suit your desires and needs.

Prerequisites Wild Shape, BSB +4

You may use your Wild Shape ability to take the form of a Humanoid as if using the Shape of the Humanoid spell.

IMPOSING WILL

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You have developed your mental skills beyond those of normal mental manipulation.

Prerequisites Cha +2

When casting a spell with the mental trait, you may warp the spell to affect creatures that would normally be immune as detailed below:

IMPROVED CRITICAL

MARTIAL

You know how to place your strikes to inflict the most harm.

Prerequisites BAB +8, Weapon Focus

Choose one weapon group for which you have already selected the Weapon Focus feat. Your attacks with this weapon group gain the Keen trait.

Be aware that if the weapon already has the Keen trait then this feat has no effect.

INJURY RELIEF

BARD FOCUS

Your psychic discipline grants you the power to heal your wounds.

Prerequisites BSB +2

You can cast Self-Healing as an innate spell with the focus trait.

INSPIRED

LOREMASTER MASTERMIND

You can draw upon magical energy to enhance your mundane skills and checks.

You gain the Inspiration Specialist Spell.

INTENSIFIED SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You enhance the raw damage of your spells.

PP Cost +4

Your spell is more powerful and increases its base damage by one die.

JUGGERNAUT

ADVANTAGE MARTIAL

You have conditioned yourself to endure physical hardships and possesses natural resilience against various afflictions.

Prerequisites Athletics 6 ranks

Action Reaction; Trigger You attempt a fortitude save, before you roll.

You gain advantage on the triggering saving throw.

KNIFE FLURRY

ATTACK FLOURISH MARTIAL

Your enemies are so easy to fool.

Prerequisites Deception 5 ranks

After a successful attack with a knife weapon, you may make a Feint (Deception) check against your opponent as a 0 AP action.

Be aware that this action has the attack trait and is therefore subject to your multiple attack penalty

LINGERING PERFORMANCE

BARD METAMAGIC

Your Bardic Specialist spells reverberate back even when you have moved on to a new masterpiece.

Prerequisites Perform 4 ranks

PP Cost +2

When casting a spell with the composition trait you can choose to allow it to continue for several rounds after you have ceased performing. The number of rounds the spell's effects linger is equal to your Cha.

Be aware that a lingering performance does not end if you use another composition spell, although you may only have one lingering performance running at any one time.

LORIST

BARD

You have dabbled in the arcane arts.

Prerequisites Arcana 5 ranks

You may learn a single arcane spell and add it to your spell repertoire. At 10th level and then every 5 levels thereafter you may add an additional arcane spell to your repertoire. These arcane spells are cast as ethereal spells and are in addition to any other spells you gain.

LUNGE

MARTIAL ROGUE

You can strike foes that would normally be out of reach.

Prerequisites BAB +2

Requirements You are wielding a melee weapon.

Using your melee weapon, you may take an action with the attack trait. This action gains the reach trait for that Strike. This strike is subject to a -1-circumstance penalty.

LUNGING STANCE

STANCE

You possess the ability to strike out at foes who are beyond your normal reach.

Prerequisites BAB +6, Lunge

Requirements You are wielding a melee weapon.

Whilst in this stance, you have the capability to make an Attack of Opportunity against an opponent positioned beyond your regular reach but still within the range achievable with Lunge. By doing so, you extend the reach of your Strike by 5 feet. Furthermore, any penalties associated with performing standard Lunge strikes are completely negated.

MAJOR ARCANE CASTER

ARCANIST

You learn some advanced arcane magic.

Prerequisites Level 12, Minor Arcane Caster

You may memorise and cast an additional arcane spell from your spellbook. At 14th level, you gain the ability to memorise and cast another additional arcane spell, and at 16th level, you can memorise and cast yet another.

Each time you are granted a new spell slot; you may also add an arcane spell of the appropriate level to your spell book.

MAJOR DIVINITY CASTER

PRIEST

You learn some advanced divinity magic.

Prerequisites Level 12, Minor Divinity Caster

You may memorise and cast an additional divinity spell. At 14th level, you gain the ability to memorise and cast another additional divinity spell and at 16th level another.

MAJOR ETHEREAL CASTER

GLEEMAN

You learn some advanced ethereal magic.

Prerequisites Level 12, Minor Ethereal Caster

You may memorise and cast an additional ethereal spell. At 14th level, you gain the ability to memorise and cast another additional ethereal spell and at 16th level another.

MAJOR VERDANT CASTER

ANIMIST

You learn some advanced verdant magic.

Prerequisites Level 12, Minor Verdant Caster

You may memorise and cast an additional verdant spell. At 14th level, you gain the ability to memorise and cast another additional verdant spell and at 16th level another.

MASTER ARCANE CASTER

ARCANIST

You learn some elite arcane magic.

Prerequisites Level 18, Major Arcane Caster

You may memorise and cast an additional two arcane spells from your spellbook. At 20th level, you gain the ability to memorise and cast another additional arcane spell.

Each time you are granted a new spell slot; you may also add an arcane spell of the appropriate level to your spell book.

MASTER DIVINITY CASTER

PRIEST

Prerequisites Level 18, Major Divinity Caster

You may memorise and cast an additional two divinity spells. At 20th level, you gain the ability to memorise and cast another additional divinity spell.

MASTER ETHEREAL CASTER

GLEEMAN

You learn some elite ethereal magic.

Prerequisites Level 18, Major Ethereal Caster

You may memorise and cast an additional two ethereal spells. At 20th level, you gain the ability to memorise and cast another additional ethereal spell.

MASTER VERDANT CASTER

ANIMIST

You learn some elite verdant magic.

Prerequisites Level 18, Major Verdant Caster

You may memorise and cast an additional two verdant spells. At 20th level, you gain the ability to memorise and cast another additional verdant spell.

MERCY OF RELIEF

CRUSADER

Your touch relieves fatigue and injury.

Prerequisites BAB +5

When using your Crusaders Mercy ability, instead of healing hit points you may instead choose to duplicate the effects of a restoration spell. This is treated as an innate spell for casting rule purposes.

MINOR ARCANE CASTER

ARCANIST

You learn some basic arcane magic.

Prerequisites Level 4

You can memorise and cast one additional arcane spell from your spellbook. At 6th level, you gain the ability to memorise and cast another additional arcane spell, and at 8th level, you can memorise and cast yet another.

Each time you are granted a new spell slot, you may also add an arcane spell of the appropriate level to your spell book.

MINOR DIVINITY CASTER

PRIEST

You learn some basic divinity magic.

Prerequisites Level 4

You may memorise and cast an additional divinity spell. At 6th level, you gain the ability to memorise and cast another additional divinity spell and at 8th level another.

MINOR ETHEREAL CASTER

GLEEMAN

You learn some basic ethereal magic.

Prerequisites Level 4

You may memorise and cast an additional ethereal spell. At 6th level, you gain the ability to memorise and cast another additional ethereal spell and at 8th level another.

MINOR VERDANT CASTER

ANIMIST

You learn some basic verdant magic.

Prerequisites Level 4

You may memorise and cast an additional verdant spell. At 6th level, you gain the ability to memorise and cast another additional verdant spell and at 8th level another.

CASTER FEATSThe caster feats grant your character additional spells of a different tradition. It is important to note that you still cannot cast spells that you do not have the required caster level for. Furthermore, if you already have a magical tradition and have gained spells from a second (or even third) tradition, your Spellcraft checks use the ability score of the new tradition and not your original one.CASTER FEATSThe caster feats grant your character additional spells of a different tradition. It is important to note that you still cannot cast spells that you do not have the required caster level for. Furthermore, if you already have a magical tradition and have gained spells from a second (or even third) tradition, your Spellcraft checks use the ability score of the new tradition and not your original one.

MOBILE SHOT

ARCHER FIGHTER RANGER STANCE

You attack with a nimble grace and deadly accuracy.

Prerequisites BAB +8

Requirements You are wielding a missile weapon.

Whilst in this stance, your ranged Strikes no longer provoke Attacks of Opportunity or trigger any other reactions triggered with ranged attacks. Furthermore, you have the ability to make an Attack of Opportunity while holding a loaded ranged weapon as long as your target is within a 5-foot.

MOBILITY

EXPERT

You move with careful and considered steps, making impossible for your enemies to strike you.

Prerequisites Acrobatics 2 ranks

When you take the Stride action, you only provoke reactions if you move more than half your Speed. This feat may also be used with other movement types.

MONSTER LORE

CLERIC CRUSADER

Your knowledge of the enemies you face is drawn from your faith as well as knowledge.

When you recall knowledge to learn about the abilities of a creature, you may add your Wisdom ability score to the check as a status bonus.

NATURAL CASTING

DRUID

You can complete the verbal and somatic components of spells even when in a different form.

Prerequisites Wild Shape, BSB +4

By harnessing your innate connection with nature, you have learned to replace the traditional verbal and somatic components of spells with a clever combination of gestures and sounds. Furthermore, you have mastered the art of utilizing material components and focuses even when they are seamlessly integrated into your transformed form.

Be aware that this feat does not grant you the ability to utilize magic items while in a form that would typically be unable to do so, and you remain unable to speak while employing your wild shape abilities.

NIMBLE DODGE

DEFENCE EXPERT

You can quickly dodge incoming attacks.

Action Reaction; Trigger A creature declares an attack against you, and you are aware of them.

Requirements You are not encumbered or subject to an ACP.

You quickly attempt to dodge the incoming attack, gaining a +2-dodge bonus against it.

NOBLE WARRIOR

GLEEMAN

You have learnt techniques of the mind and developed them to your advantage.

Prerequisites Occultism 4 ranks, Cha +3

Your ethereal prowess improves and you gain a caster level equal to half your level (round up) and low PP (1 per level). You may now memorise and cast a PP 2 ethereal spell.

OFFENSIVE PARRY

MARTIAL

Shoving an opponent with a shield in your hand has become second nature.

Prerequisites Shield Block

Action Free; Trigger You use the Shield Block reaction, and the opponent that triggered Shield Block is adjacent to you and is your size or smaller.

You shove the attacking creature as a Free Action. If the Shove would cause it to hit a solid object, enter an area of difficult terrain, or enter another creature’s space, it becomes flat-footed instead of being moved.

PLANT SHAPE

DRUID

You have learnt to take the shape of plant creatures.

Prerequisites Wild Shape, BSB +8

You may use your Wild Shape ability to take the form of a Plant as if using the Shape of the Plant spell.

POINT BLANK SHOT

ARCHER FIGHTER RANGER

Your aim is exceptionally precise when making ranged attacks at nearby targets.

Requirements You are wielding a ranged weapon.

You ignore the volley trait when using ranged weapons.

Furthermore, if your ranged weapon does not have the volley trait, you gain a +1-circumstance bonus to attack and damage rolls when attacking creatures within the weapon’s first range increment.

POWER ATTACK

ATTACK FLOURISH MARTIAL

Your powerful attack delivers a heavy blow to your foe, but it leaves you slightly off-balance.

Prerequisites BAB +6, Str +3

Action 2 AP

Requirements You are attacking with a weapon of equal or greater size.

Make a melee Strike which counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If the Strike hits, you inflict an additional 2d8 damage (same type as the base damage). As you BAB increases so does your additional damage. At BAB +12, you inflict 3d8 and at BAB +18 4d8.

PRACTISED KILLER

EXPERT FLOURISH

Your ability to ambush and snipe is quite terrifying.

Prerequisites Stealth 8 ranks

Action Free; Trigger You can use Ambush or Sniping (Stealth).

Your Ambush or Sniping (Stealth) check is made as a Free Action (0 AP) instead of a Reaction.

PRECISE SHOT

ARCHER FIGHTER RANGER

You are not easily distracted when target enemies in melee.

Prerequisites Point Blank Shot

When firing a missile weapon into melee, you ignore the +4 standard cover bonus that each target gains.

Be aware that this feat only ignores the static penalty for firing into melee, it does not ignore any additional bonuses that the target creature may gain from cover and concealment.

PRIMAL DEFENDER

ANIMIST

You have fought alongside rangers and druids picking up some of their magical knowledge.

Prerequisites Nature 4 ranks, Con +3

Your verdant prowess improves and you gain a caster level equal to half your level (round up) and low PP (1 per level). You may now memorise and cast a PP 2 verdant spell.

PROPER HARDMAN

MARTIAL

You have trained to use your strength to its fullest when making attacks with melee weapons.

Prerequisites BAB +10

Your strength is multiplied by 1.5 when determining your melee damage bonus.

QUICK DRAW

EXPERT MARTIAL

You draw your melee or thrown weapon and attack with the same motion.

Prerequisites BAB +2

You use a 1 AP to Interact and Strike with your weapon.

QUICK RELOAD

ARCHER FLOURISH

You can notch an arrow with lightning like precision.

Prerequisites BAB +4

You reduce the AP cost to reload your missile by one AP (min 0).

QUICKEN SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC FLOURISH

You can cast spells with amazing speed.

PP Cost +8

You reduce the AP cost required to cast the spell by 1 (minimum 1).

RADIANT BLADE

CRUSADER

Your blade ally is imbued with even more power.

Prerequisites Divine Ally (Blade Ally), BAB +10

You may add the aligned and flaming weapon property runes to the list that you may select during daily preparation. Any aligned trait that you select must match that of your deific aspect or deity.

REACH SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You can increase the range of your spells.

PP Cost +2

Double the range of an existing spell. If the spell has no range or a range of touch, this warping option has no effect.

REACTIVE STANCE

FIGHTER ROGUE

When there’s imminent danger, you drop into a stance with a mere thought.

Prerequisites BAB +10

Action Free; Trigger You roll initiative.

Enter any one known Stance that you know.

RESOLVE

ADEPT ADVANTAGE

You have a mind of iron when resisting mental effects.

Prerequisites Mental Focus 6 ranks

Action Reaction; Trigger You attempt a will save, before you roll.

You gain advantage on the resulting saving throw.

REVERSE STRIKE

FLOURISH MARTIAL PRESS

You turn your foes’ flanking against them with a quick reverse.

Prerequisites BAB +4

Requirements You are flanked by at least two enemies.

Action 1 AP

Make two Strike actions, one each against two separate targets that are currently flanking you. Both attacks use the same multiple attack penalty and only count as one attack for increasing the penalty further.

SACRED WEAPON

CLERIC CRUSADER

You inscribe the symbol of your deity or deific aspect onto a favoured weapon.

You etch a sacred symbol onto a favoured weapon which takes 10 minutes. This symbol remains for a full year, however if you etch a symbol onto a different weapon, the original one instantly vanishes. Once the symbol has been inscribed, the item transforms into a religious symbol of the gods, serving as a divine focus for members of your faith.

Additionally, the item also becomes a +1 Divine Spell Adder.

SECOND ALLY

CRUSADER

The power of your devotion draws additional boons from your deity.

Prerequisites Divine Ally, BAB +8

You may select an additional Divine Ally from those available to you.

SELECTIVE SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC

Select targets to avoid the wrath of your spells.

PP Cost +1 per target

When casting a spell with an area of effect you can choose several targets in the area equal to the additional PP expended. These targets are excluded from the effects of your spell.

Be aware that you must be aware of your allies to exclude them from the spell.

SELF PRESERVATION

CLERIC CRUSADER EVIL

Your focus lies in self-preservation and survivability.

Prerequisites Religion 6 ranks

Action Reaction; Trigger An enemy that you are aware of damages you with a targeted attack.

Your DR increases by 2 + half your level against the triggering attack.

Furthermore, your Strikes against the triggering creature deal +1 aligned (evil) or essence base damage until the end of your next turn. The damage type may be different each time you use this ability.

SHADOWING

MARTIAL

You instantly pursue a retreating foe.

Prerequisites BAB +4

Action Reaction; Trigger A creature within reach attempts to move away from you.

You follow a retreating creature by taking a 1 AP Stride action as a Reaction. You remain within reach of the creature until it either stops moving, or you have moved your full Speed

You can use Shadowing with any movement type that you have available.

SHIELD BLOCK

MARTIAL

You quickly block an incoming attack with your shield.

Action Reaction; Trigger You take damage from an attack.

Your shield grants you DR against the incoming attack equal to its DR bonus (if it has one). You and your shield take any further damage.

Furthermore, after using Shield Block, you lose your shield bonus to DB until the beginning of your next turn.

Be aware that if your shield does not have a DR bonus, it cannot be used to Shield Block.

SHIELD FOCUS

MARTIAL

You possess exceptional skill in using your shield to deflect incoming attacks.

You increase the DB bonus granted by any shield by +1.

SHIELDED STRIDE

AEGIS MARTAL

You deflect your enemies blows whilst moving.

Prerequisites Shield Block, BAB +4

Your shield bonus to DB is increased by +4 against actions which are provoked via movement. You cannot use Shielded Stride with a buckler.

SIGNATURE SPELL

ADEPT

Experience allows you to cast a spell with more flexibility.

Select any one of your spells, when you Warp this spell, the total PP cost of the spell is reduced by 1 PP.

SILENT SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You can cast without the use of your voice.

PP Cost +2

You remove the verbal component from a spell. This does not alter the amount of AP required to cast the spell, just prevents you from having to speak aloud when casting the spell.

SKIRMISH

FLOURISH RANGER ROGUE

Your footwork is perfection personified whilst attacking.

Prerequisites BAB +4

Action 1 AP

You may take a Strike action and Step action together for 1 AP. It matters not, which order you carry the actions out in.

SMITE EVIL

CRUSADER GOOD

You enhance your Blade Ally with a small aspect of your deity.

Prerequisites Divine Ally (Blade Ally)

Action 1 AP

Until the beginning of your next turn your Strikes made with your Blade Ally weapon inflict an additional 1d6 base good damage.

SMITE GOOD

CRUSADER EVIL

You enhance your Blade Ally with a small aspect of your deity.

Prerequisites Divine Ally (Blade Ally)

Action 1 AP

Until the beginning of your next turn your Strikes made with your Blade Ally weapon inflict an additional 1d6 base evil damage.

SPECIALIST SPELL

When you select this feat you gain a new specialist spell for which you meet the prerequisites. If a specialist spell requires a unique feat to purchase it, you may not select it with this feat.

You may select this feat multiple times, on each occasion selecting a different specialist spell.

SPELL SUBSTITUTION

ADEPT

You can switch out a prepared spell for another one from your repertoire.

Prerequisites Meditation 5 ranks, Learned Caster, BSB +5

You spend 10 minutes in quiet contemplation and then make a Meditation check with a DC equal to the casting DC of the spell.

Critical You swap the spell successfully.

Success You swap the spell successfully and may not use this ability again for another hour.

Partial As success, but you may not use this feat again until after your next daily preparation.

Failure You fail to swap the spell and may not use this feat again until after your next daily preparation.

If you are interrupted during such a swap, the original spell remains prepared and can still be cast. You can try again to swap out the spell later, but you must start the process over again.

SPLIT SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You reduce the power of your attack spell by splitting it into multiple shots.

PP Cost +4 per additional target

Your Spell Attack check is compared to the DB of multiple targets within the spell's range. The damage die of the spell attack is reduced by one step per additional target (d8 becomes d6 for one additional target or d4 two additional targets etc). This counts as one attack for your multiple attack penalty.

SPONTANEOUS SCHOLAR

ADEPT

Your extensive knowledge of magic and its intricacies enables you to cast certain spells even when you have not studied your spell library for the day. By relying on rote memory and natural talent, you can call upon a limited number of spells in moments of need.

Prerequisites Learned Caster, BSB +2, Int +2

You gain the ability to cast a number of spells without studying your spell library. The number of spells you can cast in this way equals your Intelligence ability score per day. These spells must come from your known repertoire (spells already in your spell library) and must be of a PP cost no higher than half your caster level (rounded up).

STANCE MASTERY

CONCENTRATE FIGHTER ROGUE

Your study of combat techniques is beyond compare.

Prerequisites BAB +12, Reactive Stance

Action 1 AP; Trigger You are already in a stance.

When you are in a Stance, you may activate a second stance and have both running alongside each other. Such advanced techniques are taxing however and for each round beyond the 1st that you maintain both stances you must make an Exhaustion check with a failure also resulting in both stances dropping.

STEALTHY STRIKE

EXPERT THIEF

You can catch a target off guard, to inflict serious wounds to them.

Prerequisites Non-Rogue, Stealth 2 ranks

If you Strike a creature that is flanked or that has the flat-footed condition with an agile or finesse melee attack, or a ranged weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d6 precision damage. For a ranged attack with a thrown melee weapon, that weapon must also be agile or finesse.

As your stealth skill increases, so does the amount of additional damage you inflict. Increase the amount by 1d6 for every 6 ranks you have in the skill.

STILL SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You can cast your spells without the need for hand gestures.

PP Cost +2

You remove the somatic component from a spell. This does not alter the amount of AP required to cast the spell, just prevents you from having to use somatic components.

STORMBORN

DRUID

You are at home out in the elements, revelling in the power of nature unleashed.

You take no circumstance penalties for ranged spell attacks or Perception checks caused by weather, and your targeted spells ignore the concealed condition if it is caused by weather (such as fog).

STRIDING CHARGE

FLOURISH MARTIAL

You surge forward with relentless determination, forcefully clearing a path through adversaries to swiftly close in on your intended target.

Prerequisites Athletics 5 ranks

Action 2 AP

You make one Stride action and attempt to move straight through your enemies', finishing with a melee attack. Make an Athletics check comparing the result to the Fortitude DC of each creature you attempt to pass through during your Stride action, continuing to move on a success but ending your movement before entering its space on a failure. If you reach your intended target, you may make a 1 AP Attack action.

Be aware that this action does not provoke reactions.

STRIKE OF RETRIBUTION

CLERIC CRUSADER GOOD

You place yourself in harm’s way and lash out at your enemy.

Prerequisites Religion 6 ranks

Action Reaction; Trigger An enemy damages your ally within 10 feet of you.

You move without provoking, as part of the reaction adjacent to the attacker. You then intercept the attack which targeted your ally. The attack is worked out against your Defensive Bonus and if it hits, you may immediately make a melee strike against the foe. This attack is not subject to your multiple attack bonus.

SUDDEN CHARGE

FLOURISH MARTIAL OPEN

Your ability to close the distance between you and your foes is legendary.

Prerequisites Athletics 1 rank

It only costs you 2 Action Points to Charge instead of 3.

SUPERIOR EVASION

RANGER ROGUE

Your ability to avoid damage is surpassed by very few.

Prerequisites Evasion, Acrobatics 12 ranks

When using your evasion ability, it is treated as a Free (0 AP) action and not a Reaction.

SUPERIOR JUGGERNAUT

MARTIAL

Your ability to withstand physical trauma is legendary.

Prerequisites Juggernaut, Athletics 12 ranks

When using your juggernaut ability, it is treated as a Free (0 AP) action and not a Reaction.

SUPERIOR RESOLVE

ADEPT

Your ability to resist mental effects is second to none.

Prerequisites Resolve, Mental Focus 12 ranks

When using your resolve ability, it is treated as a Free (0 AP) action and not a Reaction.

SURPRISE ATTACK

EXPERT

You can react at the beginning of a combat just a little quicker than others.

Prerequisites Perception 6 ranks

All opponents are flat-footed to you in the surprise round regardless of whether they have acted or not.

SWIPE

FLOURISH MARTIAL

You swing your weapon in a wide arc.

Prerequisites BAB +4

Spend 2 AP to perform a single melee Strike, then compare the attack result to the DB of up to two adjacent foes within your melee reach. The Swipe counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty. If your weapon has the sweep trait, its modifier applies to all Swipe attacks.

TEMPORAL EXTENSION

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You manipulate the flow of time to extend your spells beyond their natural limits.

PP Cost varies

With careful energy management, you push your magical boundaries, ensuring your power lasts when it matters most.

You can extend the duration of a spell by stepping it up to the next duration category:

• Rounds - Minutes

• Minutes - 10-Minute Intervals

• 10-Minute Intervals - Hours

• Hours - Half-Day Intervals

Each step requires a PP expenditure equal to half the spell's base PP cost, rounded up. The extension must be decided at the time of casting and does not stack with other duration modifiers.

TRACKLESS STEP

ADVANTAGE DRUID RANGER

You are very difficult to track whilst moving through areas of natural terrain.

Prerequisites Survival 5 ranks

Attempts to track you are made at disadvantage.

TURN UNDEAD

CLERIC

Calling upon the power of your god(s), you cause undead to flee from the might of your divinity.

When using your Channels ability, you may instead use the Turn Undead spell.

TWIN PARRY

FIGHTER RANGER

You use your offhand weapon to parry with great skill.

Prerequisites BAB +4

Any weapon in your offhand is considered to have the Parry trait. If your off-hand weapon already has the parry trait its bonus is increased by +1. You must have a weapon in your offhand to gain this bonus.

TWIN RIPOSTE

FIGHTER RANGER

As your target makes a mistake, you use your offhand weapon to take advantage.

Prerequisites Double Stance, BAB +8

Action Reaction; Trigger A creature within your reach fumbles a Strike against and you are in Double Stance.

You may take either an Attack or Disarm action against the target. Your multiple attack penalty does not apply to this action.

VARIABLE SUCCESS

ADEPT METAMAGIC

Your casting skills are not as delicate as your contemporaries, but usually work nonetheless.

Prerequisites BSB +8

When you get a partial result whilst casting a spell, you may expend an amount of PP equal to the base cost of the spell to change the result to a success.

VERSATILE CHANNELS

CLERIC

You can use your channels to heal more than just hit point damage.

Prerequisites BSB +8

You can expend one of your uses of channels to cast either a remove curse, remove disease, remove paralysis or restore senses spell. The spell is warped to your maximum PP.

VERSATILE FAMILIAR

WIZARD

You familiar is mutable, able to shift its focus and abilities.

Prerequisites Empower Familiar, Familiar, BSB +8

During your daily preparation, your familiar may switch out any one of its familiar abilities for another. It must meet any prerequisites for the new ability. More information on Familiars can be found at the end of this chapter.

VITAL STRIKE

ATTACK MARTIAL

You aim to strike at your targets vital points by sacrificing the amount of attacks you can make each round for more precision.

Prerequisites BAB +6

Action 2 AP

You make a single attack against your target and may specify a hit location from the following:

Arms, Legs, Torso, Abdomen or Head

If the attack is a critical hit, when you roll the critical, you may increase your critical result to the next one that affects this location.

VOID STEP

EXPERT FOCUS

You move with speed and precision, attempting to elude your target's gaze.

Prerequisites Stealth 12 ranks, Mobility

When you use a Stride action, you may choose to avoid provoking reactions during this movement. At the end of your movement, you can attempt a Stealth check against a single target's Perception DC. If successful, you are hidden from that target until the start of your next turn, unless you attack or take another noticeable action.

WARP MANIPULATION

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You have the ability to alter your spells as you have cast them.

Prerequisites BSB +10

Requirements You have successfully cast a spell and exceeded the casting DC by a minimum of 2.

Action Free

After successfully casting a spell, you may add a warping option of up to 2 PP. You must still expend the additional PP for this option.

If the result of the spell is a Critical, you may add a warping option of up to 4. This replaces the usual benefit of achieving a Critical on your spell check.

WEAPON MASTERY

MARTIAL

You rarely make mistakes when fighting with your preferred weapons.

Prerequisites Weapon Focus, BAB +6

You attack with grace and finesse when using the weapons selected from your Weapon Focus feat. You reduce the Fumble DC for all weapons covered by Weapon Focus by 1 for every 6 BAB. (to a minimum of 4).

WEAPON SPECIALISATION

FIGHTER

You are skilled at dealing damage with one weapon group.

Prerequisites Weapon Mastery, BAB +8

Choose one weapon group for which you have already selected the Weapon Focus feat. You deal +2 extra base damage when using weapons from this group.

WIDEN SPELL

ADEPT METAMAGIC

You are capable of affecting a wider area with your spells.

PP Cost +4

You can alter a burst, emanation, or spread-shaped spell to increase its area. Any numeric measurements of the spell's area increase by 100%.

WILD STRIDE

DRUID RANGER

You move quickly through natural obstacles, whether they’re tumbled stone, tangled undergrowth, or sucking mud.

You can ignore the effects of non-magical difficult terrain. As normal for ignoring difficult terrain, this also lets you treat the hindrances of formidable terrain as those of difficult terrain.

WYRM SHAPE

DRUID

You can assume the forms of the great wyrms.

Prerequisites Wild Shape, BSB +12

You may use your Wild Shape ability to take the form of a Wyrm as if using the Shape of the Wyrm spell.

Furthermore, whenever you use Wildshape to change into a different form, you gain resistance to your choice of acid, cold, electricity, fire, or poison.

GENERAL FEATS

This section deals with any feats which are associated with skills, actions or any feat that does not fall into any one of the other categories. The majority of these feats will directly interact with a skill, or an action adding bonuses or amending the way it works in some way.

ACCOMPLISHED ARTISAN

Your training focused upon the creation of one particular kind of item.

Prerequisites Any one crafting specialist skill.

When creating items using your crafting specialty, you are considered to be 2 levels higher for the purpose of determining your crafting times.

ADOPTIVE RACE

HERITAGE

You were raised by a race of humanoids other than your own, you’ve always considered yourself one of them.

Select one playable PC race (GM approval). You select your racial heritage and racial feats from the adopted race instead of your own. You cannot select any feats that require a physiological feature (such as Orc Tusks) but may be able to select such feats from your original race (GM discretion).

Garrok Bloodfang is an Orc whose tribe were destroyed by giants when he was an infant. He was adopted by an elven ranger and raised in their small village. Garrok has the Silvarni heritage and may select elven feats with no physical traits. He selects the Tusks feat at 1st level as this is a Feat that his GM deems physical.

AFFABLE

ADVANTAGE

You have the ability to create fast friends, even among those whom you have just met.

Prerequisites Diplomacy 1 rank

You gain advantage on all Make an Impression (Diplomacy) checks. Furthermore, you may affect multiple targets with this check by taking a -1-circumstance penalty for each target beyond the first.

AGILE TUMBLER

ADVANTAGE

Your swift and nimble movements allow you to weave through your opponents with unparalleled agility.

Prerequisites Acrobatics 8 ranks

You gain advantage on all Tumble (Acrobatics) checks. Furthermore, if you get a critical result on the check, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus on the next physical attack or skill check that you make, which must be made before the end of your turn.

ALCHEMICAL CRAFTING

You can create alchemical items.

Prerequisites Crafting or Nature 1 rank

You may use the Create (Crafting or Nature) action to make Alchemical items. Each item requires a formula for you to be able to make it. You may add the formula for any one level 1 Alchemical item when you select this feat.

ALERTNESS

ADVANTAGE

Your keen observational skills allow you to perceive details that often elude others.

Prerequisites Perception 10 ranks

You gain advantage on all Search (Perception) checks.

AMBUSH AWARENESS

You have a knack for avoiding blows when surprised.

Prerequisites Perception 10 ranks

If you are unable to act in the surprise round because you failed a Perception check, you can still act on your initiative count in the surprise round, but only to take the Full Defence action.

ANIMAL AFFINITY

ADVANTAGE

You have a natural empathy when dealing with creatures with the animal trait.

COMPANIONS & FAMILIARS

Venturing into the vast and often perilous expanses of the TRG world, some adventurers are fortunate to find themselves not alone, but rather accompanied by faithful comrades-in-arms known as animal companions and familiars. These are not merely pets or simple beasts of burden, but dynamic allies, each boasting its own unique capabilities and roles within the adventuring party.

ANIMAL COMPANIONS

Animal companions represent an unparalleled bond between man and beast and may be selected by those with a profound connection to the natural world, such as Rangers and Druids. These companions are typically drawn from the world's menagerie of creatures, their species reflecting the environment and culture of their master. Yet they are not your run-of-the-mill animals. The enchanting magic of their bond with their master affords them heightened intelligence and abilities, distinguishing them from their more common brethren.

Let's delve into the capabilities of an animal companion, examining the array of skills and abilities that these loyal creatures bring to an adventuring party.

TRAITS

An animal companion possesses any traits from its animal type. It also gains the Minion Trait.

Traits are explained in detail in the Appendixes.

LEVEL

An animal companion has a level equal to your level. As creatures of the animal type are a little weaker than humanoids, your animal companions’ effective level (EL) is shown in the next column.

Effective Level (EL) is explained in Chapter 12, but this is something as a player, that you do not have to keep track of.

CLASS SKILLS

An animal companion has the following class skills:

Acrobatics, Athletics, Climbing, Intimidate, Perception, Stealth and Survival. Just like a PC, an animal companion gains a class bonus to each of these skills.

SKILL POINTS

An animal companion gains 2 skill points plus wisdom ability score per level which it may spend in the same way as that of a PC.

Be aware that while there are no restrictions on the skills your animal companion can develop, it's important to consider their limitations. Skills that rely on speech, item manipulation, or high mental ability scores may be impractical or ineffective for a creature that lacks these abilities.

FEATS

An animal companion may select general feats in the same way that a player character does. Some animal companions may gain access to additional feats (GM discretion).

COMMANDING AN ANIMAL COMPANIONTo issue commands to your animal companion, you must use the Command an Animal (Handle Animal) action, for which you don't need to make a skill check and automatically gain the success result. If you choose not to command your animal companion, it will default to behaving like a typical creature of its type. However, it will always maintain a positive disposition towards you and make efforts to defend you whenever possible.COMMANDING AN ANIMAL COMPANIONTo issue commands to your animal companion, you must use the Command an Animal (Handle Animal) action, for which you don't need to make a skill check and automatically gain the success result. If you choose not to command your animal companion, it will default to behaving like a typical creature of its type. However, it will always maintain a positive disposition towards you and make efforts to defend you whenever possible.

HIT POINTS

An animal companion gains 10 + Con per level hit points. Its hit points are modified further by its Size as shown below.

BASE ATTACK/DEFENCE BONUS

An animal companion gains a base attack bonus (BAB) and a based defence bonus (BDB) as detailed in the companion table below.

SAVING THROWS

An animal companion gains saving throw bonus as detailed in the companion table below.

OTHER ABILITIES

As an animal companion increases in level, it gains a number of unique abilities as well as an ability score increase every 3rd level.

SHARE SPELLS

You have the ability to cast “Self Only” spells on your animal companion, treating them as if they were a touch spell. Additionally, you can cast spells on your animal companion even if those spells typically don't affect creatures of their type (animal).

Be aware that this ability only applies to spells and does not extend to sharing non-spell abilities, even if they resemble spells in their function.

EVASION

Your companion has learned to move quickly to avoid explosions, dragons’ breath, and worse. It gains the Evasion class feat.

IMPROVED EVASION

Your companion has almost supernatural reflexes. It gains the Superior Evasion class feat.

BASE CREATURE

The species of animal you choose is referred to as your companion's base creature. Each base creature has its own set of statistics.

• The Size entry indicates the starting size of your companion at 1st level. and shows in parentheses the companions maximum allowed size (if different).

• The companions Initiative modifier is shown.

• The Speed entry provides information about your companion's various movement speeds.

• The Senses entry lists any special senses your companion has.

• Each of your companion’s ability scores is then listed.

• Skills are then listed showing the skill name, its bonus and then amount of ranks in parentheses.

• Defensive attributes are next showing DB (and its breakdown), DR (if any) and saving throws.

• We then have the companions HP followed by any immunities, resistances or weaknesses.

• Any attacks that the companion begins play with are next.

• Finally, if the companion has any feats or special abilities they will be listed at the end of the description.

ANIMAL COMPANION INITIATIVEWhen a combat first begins, your animal companion will make their own initiative roll. The first time during a combat that you command your animal companion, they will immediately move onto your initiative count (treat as delaying if they have already acted). If an animal companion acts before you in the initiative count it will default to its animal behaviour as detailed above. ANIMAL COMPANION INITIATIVEWhen a combat first begins, your animal companion will make their own initiative roll. The first time during a combat that you command your animal companion, they will immediately move onto your initiative count (treat as delaying if they have already acted). If an animal companion acts before you in the initiative count it will default to its animal behaviour as detailed above.

COMPANION SPECIAL

Each animal companion is granted two special abilities which may either be existing feats or something unique. The unique abilities are explained here.

ACUTE SENSE

The creature has superior sense which grants it a +5 racial bonus to any specific action related to that sense.

ANIMAL RAGE

The creature may Invoke Rage (Mental Focus) without making a skill check, gaining a Critical result. The effects of this rage last for 1 minute and automatically ends as a 0 AP action at the end of this time (fatiguing the animal normally).

CONSTRICT

Action 1 AP

The creature deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures grabbed by it. Each of those creatures must attempt a Level Based (opposed) basic Fortitude save to avoid damage.

GALLOP

MOVEMENT

Action 2 AP

The creature engages in a double Stride; each move gains a 10-foot bonus to its Speed.

MONSTROUS GRAB

When making a Grapple Action, the creature gains a +4-circumstance bonus to the check. Additionally, the creature doesn’t suffer multiple attack penalties when making Grapple attempts.

MONSTROUS KNOCKDOWN

When making a Trip Action, the creature gains a +4-circumstance bonus to the check. Additionally, the creature doesn’t suffer multiple attack penalties when making Trip attempts.

PACK ATTACK

The creature’s attacks inflict an additional 1d6 precision damage when attacking any creature within reach of at least two of its allies.

POUNCE

ATTACK MOVEMENT

Action 1 AP

The creature Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the creature began this action hidden, it remains hidden until after this ability's Strike.

TRAMPLE

MOVEMENT SAVE

Action 3 AP

The creature moves up to twice its speed (minimum of 20 feet), moving through the spaces of targets which are at least one size smaller. Each target whose space it passes through with this action takes damage from the creatures’ slam attack (or other appropriate attack) with +1 base die. Targets can attempt a basic Reflex save to avoid damage.

Be aware that trample does not provoke reactions.

COMPANION FEATS

Each animal companion feat provides specific benefits and improvements to the companion's capabilities. They can enhance the companion's combat prowess, grant new skills or abilities, or improve their resilience and versatility in different situations.

An animal companion may use any of its general feat picks to select one of these feats as long as they meet any trait requirements or prerequisites.

ANIMAL ABILITY

COMPANION

Your companion is akin to others of its kind.

Your animal companion may select an ability which is available to its specific animal type.

Signus has a Cat Animal Companion which is a Lynx. A Lynx has a climb speed which Signus’ animal companion does not currently have. By selecting this feat, he may allow his cat companion to gain the lynx’s climb speed.

CONVERSE WITH MASTER

COMPANION

Your companion understand you perfectly and communicate basic information to you.

You animal companion understands completely what you are saying and will attempt to carry out your commands more efficiently as a result (GM discretion). Furthermore, your companion can convey basic information to you regarding things that it has perceived.

DEFENSIVE ROLL

COMPANION

Your animal companion is adept at using its agility to mitigate the impact of harmful attacks.

Prerequisites Level 8

Your animal companion has learned how to use a roll to lessen the impact of blows. When hit by a physical melee or ranged attack, it can use its reaction to halve the damage.

Be aware that the damage is halved after applying DR and other applicable resistances.

DEFENSIVE ROLL, IMPROVED

COMPANION

Your animal companion has developed remarkable dexterity and reflexes, allowing it to lessen the severity of damaging assaults.

Prerequisites Level 12

Your animal companion may now apply defensive roll to damage from spells.

Be aware that the animal may not use this ability to half the damage from unseen damage such as Mental and Poison.

INCREASE SIZE

COMPANION

You companion has grown in size, reaching its potential.

Prerequisites Level 5

The size of your animal companion is increased by one step. This feat cannot be used to increase your companions’ size beyond the normal maximum for a creature of its type.

MASTER TRACKER

COMPANION

Your animal companion's senses have become extraordinarily sharp.

Your animal companion can track by sense alone and gains a +4-class bonus to Track (Survival) checks.

MOUNT

COMPANION

Your animal companion's may be used as a mount.

Your animal companion has been trained to take a rider. The rider must be at least one size smaller than the animal. Furthermore, the Command an Animal (Handle Animal) action is 0 AP whilst you are mounted.

NATURAL DEFENCE

COMPANION

Your companion has learnt how to evade blows better than others.

You animal companion gains a +1 Dodge bonus to DB.

NATURAL DEFENCE, IMPROVED

COMPANION

Your companion has honed its instincts to artfully dodge incoming attacks more effectively than its peers.

Prerequisites Level 8

You animal companions Dodge bonus to DB increases by +1 taking it to a total of +2.

NATURAL DEFENCE, MASTER

COMPANION

Your companion has honed its instincts and reflexes, becoming adept at dodging attacks with greater efficiency than its counterparts..

Prerequisites Level 12

You animal companions Dodge bonus to DB increases by +1 taking it to a total of +3.

NATURAL DEFENCE, SUPREMACY

COMPANION

Through rigorous training and experience, your companion has achieved a level of mastery in dodging attacks, demonstrating exceptional prowess in evading blows compared to others.

Prerequisites Level 16

You animal companions Dodge bonus to DB increases by +1 taking it to a total of +4.

PREYING COMPANION

COMPANION

Your companion has instinctively learnt some of your technique.

Prerequisites Companions master is a Ranger

Your companion gains any bonuses granted by the hunt prey class ability when you use it.

REPLACING AN ANIMAL COMPANIONIf your animal companion dies or must be replaced for some other reason, then you must spend at least a week of downtime, searching for a replacement. Once a replacement has been found, You must achieve a success result with a Level Based Nature skill check during your next daily preparation. Your GM may allow you to replace the companion quicker.REPLACING AN ANIMAL COMPANIONIf your animal companion dies or must be replaced for some other reason, then you must spend at least a week of downtime, searching for a replacement. Once a replacement has been found, You must achieve a success result with a Level Based Nature skill check during your next daily preparation. Your GM may allow you to replace the companion quicker.

PERFECT FLANKING

COMPANION

Your companion has instinctively learnt some of your technique.

Prerequisites Support, Level 14

You and your animal companion fight as a synchronized team, employing coordinated tactics to unsettle and confuse your enemies. When you and your animal companion are positioned next to the same opponent, your combined presence grants you a flanking bonus, regardless of your actual placement on the battlefield.

SUPPORT

COMPANION

You companion is good at positioning itself to grant you tactical advantage.

If both you and your companion are engaged in melee with the same target, you both gain a +1-circumstance bonus when attacking them.

TRAMPLER

COMPANION

Your companion boasts a tougher hide, considerably more resilient than others of its kind.

Prerequisites Large size or greater

Your animal companion gains the Trample creature ability.

TOUGH HIDE

COMPANION

Your companion boasts a tougher hide, considerably more resilient than others of its kind.

You animal companions’ Natural DR is increased by 1.

TOUGH HIDE, IMPROVED

COMPANION

Your companion takes pride in its exceptionally hardy hide, exhibiting a level of durability that surpasses the norm for its species.

Prerequisites Level 6

You animal companions Natural DR is increased by 1 to a total bonus of +2.

TOUGH HIDE, MASTER

COMPANION

Your companion's hide is extraordinarily robust, exhibiting a degree of toughness that far exceeds that of its typical brethren.

Prerequisites Level 10

You animal companions Natural DR is increased by 1 to a total bonus of +3.

TOUGH HIDE, SUPREMACY

COMPANION

Through adaptation and survival, your companion has achieved a masterful level of toughness, its hide proving far more resilient than others of its kind.

Prerequisites Level 14

You animal companions’ Natural DR is increased by 1 to a total bonus of +4.

FAMILIARS

A familiar is a magical companion forged with arcane energies and is gained through the selection of the Familiar feat. The familiar serves as a loyal and trusted ally, aiding you in your magical endeavours and offering various benefits and abilities.

FAMILIAR FORM

When you first create your familiar you must choose the form of a tiny animal. This is the form that your familiar takes although it has little bearing upon your familiars’ abilities.

Theolan selects the familiar feat and makes the decision that his familiar will have the appearance of an owl. This does not grant the familiar any unique abilities (such as flight) possessed by an owl, but the familiar has the visual appearance of an owl.

FAMILIAR STAT BLOCK

When you first gain a familiar it has the following statistics:

FAMILIARSize Tiny; Initiative +25Speed 25Senses NightvisionStr -2, Dex 3, Con 0, Int -2, Wis 2, Cha 0DB 15 (BDB 10, Stat +3, Class +2); DR 1 (base)Bite (Tiny) +3 (1d4-2 piercing)FAMILIARSize Tiny; Initiative +25Speed 25Senses NightvisionStr -2, Dex 3, Con 0, Int -2, Wis 2, Cha 0DB 15 (BDB 10, Stat +3, Class +2); DR 1 (base)Bite (Tiny) +3 (1d4-2 piercing)

TRAITS

A familiar gains the Minion Trait.

Traits are explained in detail in the Appendixes.

LEVEL

A familiar has a level equal to your level. A familiar, although considered to be an extension of your power still effects your party APL (see Chapter 12). A familiar has an Effective Level (EL) of half your level (round down).

SKILLS

A familiar develops no skill ranks of its own but instead has an amount of ranks equal to any you develop in each skill. Furthermore, a familiar also gains any class bonuses that you have to skills. Finally, a familiar can only use a skill if it would be physically possible to do so with its form.

FEATS

A familiar gains no additional feats as you advance in level but does gain special abilities as described below.

HIT POINTS

A familiar has an amount of hit points equal to half of your characters (round up).

BASE ATTACK/DEFENCE BONUS

A familiar gains a base attack bonus (BAB) and a based defence bonus (BDB) equal to your characters.

SAVING THROWS

A familiar gains the same saving throw bonuses as you. A familiar gains a special +2 racial bonus to any saving throws made to resist magic.

COMMANDING A FAMILIARTo command your familiar, you must use a 1 AP (Interact) action. If you do not command your familiar it will follow you and engage in no further activity. Unlike an animal companion, a familiar only gains 2 AP a round (unless the Familiar Focus ability is selected – see below). COMMANDING A FAMILIARTo command your familiar, you must use a 1 AP (Interact) action. If you do not command your familiar it will follow you and engage in no further activity. Unlike an animal companion, a familiar only gains 2 AP a round (unless the Familiar Focus ability is selected – see below).

LOSS OF A FAMILIARIf a familiar dies or is dismissed, you must attempt a Fortitude Save (level based) with the following results:Critical Did you have a familiar? You may obtain a new familiar immediately.Success You feel a sense of loss but recover quickly. You may obtain a new familiar during your next daily preparation.Failure You have a sense of weakness and suffer fatigue 2 which can only be recovered through a night’s rest. You may obtain a new familiar during your next daily preparation.Fumble As failure but you may not obtain a new familiar for one whole week.Be aware that these rules also apply if you die and are then brought back to life.Obtaining a FamiliarTo obtain a familiar you must spend an hour in quiet meditation immediately after daily preparation. At the end of this time, you must expend 100 gp per level in magical components. A new familiar is then summoned to your side.LOSS OF A FAMILIARIf a familiar dies or is dismissed, you must attempt a Fortitude Save (level based) with the following results:Critical Did you have a familiar? You may obtain a new familiar immediately.Success You feel a sense of loss but recover quickly. You may obtain a new familiar during your next daily preparation.Failure You have a sense of weakness and suffer fatigue 2 which can only be recovered through a night’s rest. You may obtain a new familiar during your next daily preparation.Fumble As failure but you may not obtain a new familiar for one whole week.Be aware that these rules also apply if you die and are then brought back to life.Obtaining a FamiliarTo obtain a familiar you must spend an hour in quiet meditation immediately after daily preparation. At the end of this time, you must expend 100 gp per level in magical components. A new familiar is then summoned to your side.

FAMILIAR ABILITIES

As a familiar increases in level, it may select a number of unique abilities. A familiar begins at 1st level with 2 abilities and the Empathic Link ability. These abilities may be selected from those below. A familiar must meet any prerequisites required by the ability.

At 4th level and then every 4 levels thereafter, you may select an additional ability for your familiar.

ABILITY ENHANCEMENT

Your familiar may increase any one ability score by 1.

This ability may be selected multiple times but never more than once every four levels.

AMPHIBIOUS

Your familiars physical form adapts with features like webbed feet or hands for better propulsion in water. Your familiar gains a swim speed of 25-feet.

BURROWER

Your familiar's forelimbs develop stronger, more durable claws or paws. These may resemble the enlarged, spade-like claws of a mole or badger, perfect for digging through soil and rock. Your familiar gains a burrow speed of 25-feet.

CANTRIP BEARER

You prepare an additional Cantrip which is stored in your familiar. Either you or your familiar may cast this Cantrip as long as you are within 30-feet of each other. Your familiar uses your Spellcraft bonus when casting spells but takes a -4 penalty to the check for each component it cannot satisfy.

CLIMBER

Your familiar develops claws or grippy pads on its feet for better traction, a more muscular or flexible body for moving up vertical surfaces, and possibly a prehensile tail to aid in balance and grasp onto branches or ledges. Your familiar gains a climb speed of 25-feet.

DARKVISION

Your familiar gains Darkvision.

DELIVER TOUCH SPELLS

Prerequisites Level 4

Your familiar can deliver touch spells for you. If you and the familiar are in contact at the time you cast a touch spell, you can designate your familiar as the “toucher.” The familiar can then deliver the touch spell just as you would.

Be aware that the spell must be delivered before the end of the familiar’s next turn.

EMPATHIC LINK

You have an empathic link with your familiar to a 1-mile distance. You can communicate empathically with the familiar but cannot see through its eyes. Because of the link's limited nature, only general emotions can be shared.

ENERGY RESISTANT

Your familiar gains resistance to one energy type.

EVASION

Your familiar has learned to move quickly to avoid explosions, dragons’ breath, and worse. It gains the Evasion class feat.

FAMILIAR FOCUS

Prerequisites Level 4

Your familiar is quicker than most and gains 3 AP when you command instead of 2 AP.

FAST MOVEMENT

Your familiar’s movement types increase their speeds by 15 -feet.

FLIER

Your familiar develops wings, be they feathered, membranous, or even magically ethereal, depending on its base form. Its body might become lighter and more streamlined for better aerodynamics, and it might develop more powerful muscles in its chest and wings for sustained flight. Your familiar gains fly speed of 25-feet.

GENERAL ADEPTNESS

Your familiar may select any one general feat foe which it meets the prerequisites and is physically and mentally able to use (GM discretion).

This ability may be selected multiple times, each time selecting a different general feat.

GILLS

Prerequisites Amphibious

Your familiar grows a set of gills, allowing it to breathe water in addition to air.

IMPROVED EVASION

Your familiar has almost supernatural reflexes. It gains the Superior Evasion class feat.

MANUAL DEXTERITY

Your familiar can use up to two of its limbs as if they were hands to perform manipulate actions.

REJUVENATION

Whenever you are magically healed, your familiar is subjected to the same effect as long as it is within 30 feet of you.

RESILIENCE

Your familiar becomes more resistance to physical and mental effects and gains a +2 racial bonus to all Saving Throws.

SCENT

Your familiar gains scent.

SHARE SENSES

Prerequisites Level 4

Once every 10 minutes, you can use a single action with the concentrate trait to project your senses into your familiar. When you do, you lose all sensory information from your own body but can sense through your familiar's body for up to 1 minute. You can Dismiss this effect.

SHARE SPELLS

You have the ability to cast “Self Only” spells on your familiar, treating them as if they were a touch spell. Any spell that would normally affect you will also affect your familiar.

Be aware that this ability only applies to spells and does not extend to sharing non-spell abilities, even if they resemble spells in their function.

SPEAK IN TONGUES

Prerequisites Level 8, Speak with Master

Your familiar, through its magical connection with you, gains the unique ability to understand and communicate in any one language that you know.

SPEAK WITH KIND

Prerequisites Level 8

Your familiar can communicate with creatures of a type similar to its forged image. So, a familiar that resembles an owl would be able to converse with other avians, a cat with other felines etc. Such communication is limited by the Intelligence of the conversing creatures.

SPEAK WITH MASTER

Prerequisites Level 4

You and your familiar can communicate verbally. Other creatures cannot understand what you are saying and to them it simply sounds like gibberish.

SPELL BATTERY

Your familiar acts as a +1 Spell Adder allowing you to cast any one spell from your repertoire each day with no power point cost. Your familiar must be within 30 feet of you to use this ability.

SPELLCASTER

Prerequisites Level 8, Cantrip Bearer or Spell Battery

Your familiar gains 1 PP per level and may cast spells from your spell repertoire. It can only cast spells of a maximum PP equal to your caster level/2 (round up). Your familiar uses your Spell Skill when casting spells but takes a -4 penalty to the check for each component it cannot satisfy.

TOUGH

Your familiar's maximum Hit Points increase by 2 per level.

CHAPTER 6 - GEAR & SERVICES

Vladivar, clad in gleaming armour and wielding mighty weapons, stood at the precipice of adventure. His armour, meticulously crafted by skilled artisans, hugged his form with a perfect balance of protection and agility. Each plate and chainmail piece glistened in the sunlight, bearing intricate engravings that spoke of his valour. His weapons, forged with ancient techniques and infused with magical enhancements, felt like extensions of his very being. The sword, honed to a razor-sharp edge, sang with anticipation, while the shield, emblazoned with enchanted runes, stood as an unyielding barrier against any foe. Equipped as such, Vladivar exuded confidence, ready to face the perils that awaited him with unmatched skill and determination.

Every adventurer needs a good sword, armour and other adventuring gear to begin their career with. As the destiny of a character forges forward, so does their amassing fortune. This can be in coin, gems and many other items of importance.

This chapter focuses on all the non-magical equipment available in the game as alchemical items and services.

CURRENCY

The coin most used in TRG is the gold piece (gp), or lion. Each gold piece is a standard weight of gold. Gear prices are usually listed in gold pieces with a ‘gp’ after the number of coins.

There are three other common types of coins, each likewise standardized in weight and value. The first is the copper piece (cp), or penny. Each copper piece is worth one‑hundredth of a gold piece. The second is the silver piece (sp), or falcon. Each silver piece is worth one-tenth of a gold piece. The platinum piece (pp), or sphinx is often used for purchasing magic items and other expensive items, as 1 platinum piece is worth 10 gold pieces. The mithril piece (mp), or dragon, is used by nobles to demonstrate their wealth, for the purchase of very expensive items, or simply to easily transport large sums of currency. A mithril piece is worth 100 gold pieces.
